A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard’s affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help. They’re the captains of the Revolutionary Army.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!
sub.description:
At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!
sub.description:
Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague, Admiral Ryokugyu.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!
sub.description:
Stelly, Sabo’s adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi sees the surface world for the first time.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca`s Sentiments!
sub.description:
Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!
sub.description:
Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!
sub.description:
Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon, but luckily an old friend of the Ryugu Kingdom is on hand and tries to defuse the situation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Explosive Situation! Two Emperors of the Sea Going After Luffy!
sub.description:
The Emperors of the Sea, Big Mom and Kaido decide to team up against Luffy! Meanwhile, Garp hears about the wild exploits of his grandson, all while a mysterious outsider visits the highest authority in the world!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!
sub.description:
After sneaking into the Land of the Gods, Sabo sees the shocking figure of his friend – Kuma! Abused by the World Government as a pawn in their games, Kuma, who was made an example of what happens when you disobey the gods!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally, It Starts! The Conspiracy-filled Reverie!
sub.description:
The Reverie has begun! The representative kings and queens first discuss what to do with Straw Hat Luffy. Meanwhile the Revolutionary Army confirms its desire to save Kuma! All while they recount how the Straw Hats have grown from upstarts into world players!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Marco! The Keeper of Whitebeard`s Last Memento!
sub.description:
In order to recruit a strong ally towards bringing down Kaido, Cat Viper and his crew stop by Whitebeard’s homeland to see Marco, the 1st division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Climbing up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano`s Sea Zone!
sub.description:
Luffy and the others become excited as they see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie while they close in on the Land of Wano. But this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious! The sea itself is a barrier!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Land of Wano! To the Samurai Country Where Cherry Blossoms Flutter!
sub.description:
A mysterious country, a rampaging slasher, ancient samurai rituals of seppuku - and Zoro in the crosshairs! When a street assault occurs, all signs point to Zoro! Meanwhile, Luffy finally arrives at the Land of Wano but all his friends are nowhere to be found.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Otama Appears! Luffy vs. Kaido`s Army!
sub.description:
Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some mysterious, and dangerous, local fauna! And then, he meets a little girl named Otama! Meanwhile, Zoro makes trouble for the others who are trying to blend in!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: He`ll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
sub.description:
Otama`s gratitude towards Luffy knows no bounds! But the feast she cooks him exhausts her food stores completely! As she suffers from poor drinking water, her companion tells the story of the mysterious outsider she waits for - Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Side Story! The World`s Greatest Bounty Hunter, Cidre!
sub.description:
Ambushed and outgunned by a skilled bounty hunter Cidre’s group, the Straw Hats rely on the Sunny`s Coup de Burst to escape! But they end up stranded without cola! A nearby soda island offers a solution - but Luffy is quickly in over his head! Luckily a vivacious old friend is nearby!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
sub.description:
Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding Through the Wasteland!
sub.description:
Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido`s underlings show up too!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!
sub.description:
Otama’s temperature is going up and Luffy has no time to waste! However, Hawkins, one of Kaido’s Headliners, blocks their way by showing his unique powers and skills which can harm his own men.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Defeat Is Inevitable! The Strawman`s Fierce Attack!
sub.description:
Luffy and Zoro have been stalled by Hawkins but their fortune looks bright as they are guided by a woman who Zoro had saved. She leads them to a teahouse and to an herbal remedy for the river poison. All the while, old acquaintances look on from a distance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Greatest Day of My Life! Otama and Her Sweet Red-bean Soup!
sub.description:
Otama`s life is saved by Otsuru at her teahouse. The proud Otama finds it hard to take more kindness. The group learns of the Okobore Town - living on the cast-offs of the officials! Then, suddenly, they were attacked by the Shogun’s men!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Charging into the Enemy`s Territory! Bakura Town: Where Officials Thrive!
sub.description:
Otama has been kidnapped by the Gifters! She is taken to a flourishing town called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking Headliner was expecting her. Luffy and Zoro rush to rescue her along with a samurai, Okiku!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Yokozuna Appears! The Invincible Urashima Goes After Okiku!
sub.description:
As Luffy, Zoro, and Okiku bounce through Bakura Town on Komachiyo’s back, looking for the kidnapped Otama, a sumo wrestler comes flying towards them! Interested, they go down to watch sumo but the undefeated yokozuna Urashima has been expecting Okiku there and shows his brutal nature!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Climactic Sumo Battle! Straw Hat vs. the Strongest Ever Yokozuna!
sub.description:
Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in the Land of Wano, to a sumo match! Urashima even uses illegal moves to beat Luffy at any cost! Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he knows she committed a crime and he has to punish her for it.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Rages! Rescue Otama from Danger!
sub.description:
After sending the yokozuna Urashima flying, Luffy and his clan continue their search for Bakura Town’s boss to save Otama! They finally find the boss, Holdem, one of the Beast Pirates’ Headliners, and Otama who is hanging in the mouth of a lion in Holdem’s stomach.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Taking Back Otama! A Fierce Fight Against Holdem!
sub.description:
Facing Holdem who is holding Otama as hostage, Luffy prepares for a fight but Okiku tries to stop him by sharing who is really ruling the region. Meanwhile, Basil Hawkins who is also working for Kaido and chasing after Luffy, is confronted by a mysterious figure.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Duel! The Magician and the Surgeon of Death!
sub.description:
Taking down Holdem, Luffy rescues Otama and tries to catch up to Zoro and Okiku who stole the food treasure ship and started a mad dash to get out of the town! Meanwhile, Trafalgar Law’s attempt to silence Basil Hawkins fails when he hears bad news about his alliance.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Romance Dawn
sub.description:
This is a story of Luffy in an alternate reality. While sailing on the sea by himself, a strange bird crashes into his small boat. He looks up to find a giant ship where a girl named Ann has been captured. It seems like the bird belongs to her.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Coming of the Treasure Ship! Luffytaro Returns the Favor!
sub.description:
Zoro and the others dash out of BakuraTown on the treasure ship filled with food! Luffy catches up to them bringing ahuge bucket of fresh water! Then, they distribute the food and the water to thepeople of Okobore Town who were thirsty and hungry.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mysterious Grave Markers! A Reunion at the Ruins of Oden Castle!
sub.description:
Luffy arrives at the ruins of Oden Castle following Law and finds the graves of his friends, Kin’emon and the others. As Law starts telling the already-stunned Luffy about the creepy story of Kin’emon’s ghost, Luffy sees it coming towards him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Legendary Samurai! The Man Who Roger Admired!
sub.description:
Kin’emon tells Luffy and the others about how Kozuki Oden made Kuri into a peaceful region and became its Daimyo. However, he was set up by Kaido and Kurozumi Orochi and executed. Kin’emon and his fellow vassals ran to Oden Castle in flames to save Oden’s wife Toki and children but Toki told him a shocking truth.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Bringing Down the Emperor of the Sea! A Secret Raid Operation Begins!
sub.description:
Kin’emon and the others crossed through time by the power of Kozuki Toki, Momonosuke’s mother, and arrived at the Land of Wano 20 years later, a totally different country before their eyes. However, discovering that there were still their allies there, they started preparing to take down Kaido and Orochi who ruined the country.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strongest Man in the World! Shutenmaru, the Thieves Brigade Chief!
sub.description:
Ashura Doji, one of the allies Kin’emon wants to search for, has become the head of a thieves brigade and they now raid Okobore Town taking away the food that Luffy gave to the people. Ashura Doji, under the name Shutenmaru, then faces Kaido’s right-hand man and gets into a fierce fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everyone Is Annihilated! Kaido`s Furious Blast Breath!
sub.description:
The drunken Kaido flies above Okobore Town in his dragon form and threatens Shutenmaru and all the people in the town. Luffy, Law, Kin’emon, and Okiku start running towards the town to rescue them. However, Kaido heads towards the ruins of Oden Castle where they left their crew behind.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally Clashing! The Ferocious Luffy vs. Kaido!
sub.description:
After Luffy sees Kaido shattering the ruins of Oden Castle where he left his friends, he becomes enraged and attacks Kaido! Soon after, he finds out Kaido even assaulted Otama who was riding on Speed’s back to her home. Furious, Luffy reveals himself to Kaido and starts to retaliate!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Destructive! One Shot, One Kill: Thunder Bagua!
sub.description:
An infuriated Luffy strikes blow after blow on the drunken Kaido. When he activates Gear Four Bounce-Man and launches even more powerful attacks, Kaido fights back and knocks him out with just one blow. Law tries to rescue Luffy but is interrupted by Hawkins and now Kaido approaches Luffy, unconscious on the ground.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Living Hell! Luffy, Humiliated in the Great Mine!
sub.description:
Luffy gets beaten by Kaido and is sent to a great mine where prisoners are made to work in forced labor. There, he finds an unexpected reunion. Meanwhile, Okiku is rushing to the ruins of Oden Castle in order to confirm the safety of the Straw Hats and the others.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Holyland in Tumult! Emperor of the Sea Blackbeard Cackles!
sub.description:
On Gloom Island in the Grand Line, Perona finds out that her captain, Gecko Moria, is alive and she is about to leave Dracule Mihawk who let her stay there for the last two years. Meanwhile, Moria raids the Pirate Island of Fullalead with his zombie army to take back his friend from Blackbeard.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: It`s On! The Special Operation to Bring Down Kaido!
sub.description:
Dogstorm fights against Shutenmaru to ally with him for their operation but Shutenmaru still rejects their call. Meanwhile, Sanji and the others are on their mission to recruit like-minded people who become skeptical as they receive the secret message from the Kozuki Clan.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Rampage! The Prisoners: Luffy and Kid!
sub.description:
In the Excavation Labor Camp, Luffy competes against Kid by hauling stones for food and they both get tons of it. However, Dobon, a vice warden, becomes furious when he finds out all their provisions are gone, and gives Luffy and Kid a new sentence: death.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Great Sensation! Sanji`s Special Soba!
sub.description:
Sanji’s Special Soba becomes very popular but some gang members come to disturb his business and knock over a customer’s bowl. Infuriated, Sanji takes them down and gives the customer, a little girl named Toko, another serving. Later, Sanji and his friends find out that Toko is an attendant to an important figure in the Land of Wano.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luxurious and Gorgeous! Wano`s Most Beautiful Woman: Komurasaki!
sub.description:
Wano’s top courtesan Komurasaki is in procession and slowly makes her way to Orochi Palace. There is a crowd of people on the street as well as Sanji and the others. While everyone is fascinated by her, some seeking vengeance get in the Oiran’s way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Tale of Chivalry! Zoro and Tonoyasu`s Little Trip!
sub.description:
Zoro who has been wandering around the Land of Wano since he got separated from his friends meets a sycophant named Tonoyasu. Tonoyasu paid for Zoro’s sushi and to pay him back, Zoro gambles at dice. However, he realizes that the dealer and the others are cheating.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A State of Emergency! Big Mom Closes In!
sub.description:
Zoro is taken to the sycophant Tonoyasu’s poor hometown, Ebisu Town where people laugh away their misfortune. On the other hand, Wano’s Shogun – Orochi has a lavish banquet while Big Mom is closing in on the country at a furious speed.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Capitol in an Uproar! Another Assassin Targets Sanji!
sub.description:
As the Big Mom Pirates approach the Land of Wano, Kaido’s subordinates led by King and Queen try to get rid of them. Meanwhile, in the Flower Capital, another member of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, Page One, attacks every soba restaurant in the city, in search of Sanji.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dashing! The Righteous Soba Mask!
sub.description:
Sanji faces Page One, a Headliner of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, who questions the soba cook’s true identity. Sanji uses Germa’s device for the first time and transforms himself into Stealth Black while dubbing himself Soba Mask.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Desperate Situation! Orochi`s Menacing Oniwabanshu!
sub.description:
While the banquet grows livelier at Orochi’s Castle, Robin is confronted by his ninja force called Oniwabanshu. In the meanwhile in Kuri, Chopper, Tama, and Momonosuke train themselves preparing for the incoming battle but are interrupted when they find someone washed up on the beach.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Pandemonium! The Monster Snake, Shogun Orochi!
sub.description:
At the banquet, the Shogun Orochi starts to talk about his late old enemy which bores the attendees. Suddenly, the Oiran’s child attendant Toko bursts with laughter and won’t stop. Orochi becomes furious and attacks her, but an unexpected person stands in his way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Flower Falls! The Final Moment of the Most Beautiful Woman in the Land of Wano!
sub.description:
In order to save her child attendant Toko, the top Oiran Komurasaki stands up to the Shogun Orochi, but the yakuza boss Kyoshiro interrupts and does something that no one expected. Meanwhile, Robin is trying to get out of Orochi’s Castle with the help of Nami and Brook.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Bond Between Prisoners! Luffy and Old Man Hyo!
sub.description:
Nami, Robin, and the others got away from Oden’s Castle and now discuss what they have found out about the enemy so far. Meanwhile, Chopper’s group sets off to rescue Luffy from the Excavation Labor Camp where, at the same time, Luffy is in big trouble.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Lead Performer! Queen the Plague Emerges!
sub.description:
At the Excavation Labor Camp in Udon, Luffy tries to save Old Man Hyo and stands up to Vice Warden Daifuku and Warden Babanuki with his physical strength weakened by the Sea Prism Stone cuffs. Then when a Lead Performer of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, Queen the Plague, comes to the camp, Luffy makes an escape!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Climb Up! Luffy`s Desperate Escape!
sub.description:
Luffy and Old Man Hyo try to climb up the wall and break out of the Excavation Labor Camp, but Queen the Plague stands in their way and gives them a hard time! Meanwhile, Nami and Robin experience a public bathhouse along with Shinobu and come to know about the Land of Wano’s great yakuza boss.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dead or Alive! Queen`s Sumo Inferno!
sub.description:
Luffy fights quite a few Queen’s men at once in the deadly sumo match while protecting Old Man Hyo! Meanwhile, Nami, Robin, and Shinobu are cornered as Hawkins comes to raid the bathhouse. However, someone who they don’t expect to be there pops up from nowhere to save them.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Gyukimaru! Zoro Fights a Duel on Bandit`s Bridge!
sub.description:
Luffy deals with the endless supply of opponents trying to figure out the way to use Haki that Rayleigh taught him a while ago. Meanwhile, Zoro faces Gyukimaru who is accusing him of stealing Shusui, however, their duel is interrupted by a woman’s scream.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: A Big Turnover! The Three-Sword Style Overcomes Danger!
sub.description:
The duel between Zoro and Gyukimaru is interrupted by Kamazo, Orochi’s assassin who came after a little girl Toko. Without Shusui, Zoro has a hard time fighting the two at the same time, but he finds an unlikely third sword to take down the enemies.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zoro, Stunned! The Shocking Identity of the Mysterious Woman!
sub.description:
Luffy’s next enemies in the deadly sumo match in the Excavation Labor Camp are two tough Gifters. Much to Old Man Hyo’s surprise, Luffy keeps practicing using Haki properly at the same time as he fights them. Meanwhile, the wounded Zoro wakes up to find out the stunning identity of the mysterious woman he saved.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Get the Hang of It! The Land of Wano`s Haki: Ryuo!
sub.description:
Hiyori tells Zoro a stunning story of escaping the incident 20 years ago and surviving until the present day. Meanwhile, Luffy stills struggles to master the Haki of the Color of Arms, but a surprising person steps up and gives an example.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tonoyasu! Ebisu Town`s Most Loved!
sub.description:
Luffy continues training himself to use Haki with Old Man Hyo’s help, but the battle is suddenly suspended and shortly thereafter Raizo appears in front of them. Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and the others are wondering who Tonoyasu, Ebisu Town’s hero, really is.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shaking the Nation! The Identity of Ushimitsu Kozo the Chivalrous Thief!
sub.description:
Ushimitsu Kozo the great thief who robbed from the rich and gave to the poor gets caught and his true identity stuns Orochi and the others. When Toko hears the news, she gets very upset and so is Zoro when he hears the reason.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hats Run! Save the Captive Tonoyasu!
sub.description:
Tonoyasu has been strung up and is soon-to-be executed. The people of the Land of Wano recognize who he really is and start raising their voice while the Straw Hats rush to save him. Then, Tonoyasu starts addressing the nation and the corrupt Shogun Orochi.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zoro`s Fury! The Truth About the Smile!
sub.description:
By the time Kin’emon and the others notice that Yasuie is trying to sacrifice his life to save their raid plan, it was all too late. Ebisu Town`s people laughing out loud annoys Zoro, but when Hiyori tells him the reason behind it, he is in for a shock!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Toko`s Tears! Orochi`s Pitiless Bullets!
sub.description:
Hiyori and Shinobu tearfully tell the Straw Hats the truth behind Ebisu Town residents` cheerfulness and smiles, which infuriates them. When Yasuie’s daughter, Toko, runs to her father’s body, Orochi recognizes who she is and takes a shot at her!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hats Step In! An Uproarious Deadly Battle at the Execution Ground!
sub.description:
Zoro and Sanji start fighting against Orochi’s clan. Nami and the rest of the Straw Hats join them. Meanwhile, at the Excavation Labor Camp, a new criminal, Hitokiri Kamazo, has arrived. And someone else who is brought to the site reveals the shocking truth about Kamazo.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy`s Determination! Win Through the Sumo Inferno!
sub.description:
Zoro keeps fighting Kyoshiro, but Orochi’s Oniwabanshu comes to back Kyoshiro up. Meanwhile, at the Excavation Labor Camp, Queen announces the restart of the Sumo Inferno with a new cruel rule which is painful not only to Luffy, but also to Drake and Killer.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Storm Has Come! A Raging Big Mom!
sub.description:
Kin’emon apologizes Ashura Doji AKA Shutenmaru for goading Holdem to attack Atamayama where Ashura’s hideout was located, and asks him to join the fight against Kaido. Meanwhile, Chopper and his group finally arrived at the Excavation Labor Camp and Big Mom forces her way in to find her favorite soup!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Grudge over Red-bean Soup! Luffy Gets into a Desperate Situation!
sub.description:
Craving red-bean soup, Big Mom attacks Queen, the Animal Kingdom Pirates’ Lead Performer who reins over Udon. However, when she finds out that the pot is empty, she turns her wrath against the one who ate it all: Luffy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Stop the Emperor of the Sea! Queen`s Secret Plan!
sub.description:
After finding out that Luffy ate the whole pot ofthe red-bean soup that she was looking for, Big Mom becomes infuriated and goesafter him. Meanwhile, Queen, the Lead Performer, comes up with a plan to stopthe rampaging Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Brutal Ammunition! The Plague Rounds Aim at Luffy!
sub.description:
Queen hastily ties up the sleeping Big Mom and carries her to Onigashima leaving Udon to Babanuki. Babanuki uses a weapon that Queen made to threaten inmates and make them catch Luffy, but a mysterious figure emerges from the forbidden cell to save Luffy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Start Fighting Back! Luffy and the Akazaya Samurai!
sub.description:
Kawamatsu the Kappa is freed and stands up against Babanuki and his underlings! Listening to Old Man Hyo’s suggestion, Raizo and Kiku reveal their true identities which give the desperate prisoners not only a shock but also some hope.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: We`re Here to Win! Luffy`s Desperate Scream!
sub.description:
Luffy faces those who are infected by the Plague Rounds and the non-infected prisoners who submit to the authority of Udon. To open their eyes, Luffy takes a measure that will risk his life. However, the Chief Warden Babanuki has something up his sleeve.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Warriors` Dream! Luffy`s Conquer of Udon!
sub.description:
The freed prisoners in Udon refuse to fight alongside Luffy because he is a pirate. Raizo and Old Man Hyo try their best to convince them, but an unexpected person stands up to bring the prisoners hope after taking down Kaido!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Orochi`s Hunting Party! The Ninja Group vs. Zoro!
sub.description:
After standing against Orochi, Zoro and Hiyori are chased by Orochi’s ninja group. Meanwhile, Orochi is told that they captured Trafalgar Law as the people of the Flower Capital prepare for the upcoming Fire Festival.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tension Rises in Onigashima! Two Emperors of the Sea Meet?!
sub.description:
Nami and Franky join Kanjuro who has taken Yasuie’s dead body to bury him with Oden, and together they hit the road. Robin, Usopp, and Brook are at the dock trying to figure out a way to pass through a check point. Meanwhile, Big Mom and Kaido finally clash at Onigashima.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Hiyori`s Confession! A Reunion at Bandit`s Bridge!
sub.description:
As the clash between Kaido and Big Mom continues, Queen looks for a way to get out of Onigashima. Meanwhile in Udon, Old Man Hyo finds his former allies, four bosses from each region. At Bandit’s Bridge, Hiyori and Kawamatsu finally see each other after a long time.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Its Name Is Enma! Oden`s Great Swords!
sub.description:
Zoro runs after the warrior-monk who took his Shusui and Kawamatsu shares with Hiyori his memory of a fox that was guarding the graves in Ringo. As they catch up to Zoro, they find a room filled with swords. And Hiyori tells Zoro to give Shusui back to the Land of Wano.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: A New Alliance?! Kaido`s Army Gathers!
sub.description:
As the day of the raid approaches, Law finds someone who might help him escape the prison and Kin’emon gathers up most of his main allies to discuss the raid plan. Meanwhile, at Onigashima, Kaido and Big Mom make a stunning declaration!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ticking Down to the Great Battle! The Straw Hats Go into Combat Mode!
sub.description:
Kin’emon, Momonosuke, and the others can’t fight back tears when they hear that Hiyori is alive.
Zoro is stunned by Enma’s demonic power and its ties to him.
And as the day of the Fire Festival is finally in sight, Kin’emon and the others head out for the rendezvous point.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Big News! An Incident That Will Affect the Seven Warlords!
sub.description:
The resolution that passed the Reverie and the incidents surrounding the conference stun people all over the world and corner the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Meanwhile, a Navy captain Koby secretly contacts someone who is currently in the Land of Wano.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Legendary Battle! Garp and Roger!
sub.description:
Admiral Issho and Fleet Admiral Sakazuki argue over the abolition of the Seven Warlord system and the alliance of the two Emperors of the Sea. Meanwhile, ex-Fleet Admiral Sengoku teaches the young Navy soldiers about the legendary Rocks Pirates that Kaido and Big Mom once belonged to along with all the other big names.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Rendezvous Port! The Land of Wano Act Three Begins!
sub.description:
On the day of the Fire Festival, Orochi leaves the mainland of the Land of Wano heading for Onigashima where a big banquet will take place. Meanwhile, at Tokage Port, the rendezvous point for the rebel group, Kin’emon and the others are stunned by the fact that none of their allies are there.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Number-One Samurai in the Land of Wano! Here Comes Kozuki Oden!
sub.description:
The night before the great battle, Orochi orders the destruction of the Sunny along with some bridges across the country to block Akazaya samurai’s allies from their rendezvous. Disappointed, the group of samurai still sets out for Onigashima with the memory of their beloved lord, Oden, in their hearts. However, 41 years ago, Oden was not respected by everyone.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tearfully Swearing Allegiance! Oden and Kin`emon!
sub.description:
When the angry mountain god, the giant boar, almost kills Kin’emon, Oden steps in. Kin’emon is impressed when he sees Oden’s strength and pledges his life to serve him. Disavowed by his father, Oden decides to go on a journey around the country and gathers more followers along the way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Changing Destiny! The Whitebeard Pirates Cast Ashore!
sub.description:
Oden transforms the wild land of Kuri into a habitable region and is made Daimyo over it. Then he meets Kawamatsu the Kappa and the two Minks, Dogstorm and Cat Viper, who become his followers like the others. Kin’emon and the other vassals are scolded by Yasuie when they try to steal money from him, and they begin reforming themselves for their lord Oden.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Oden`s Determination! Whitebeard`s Test!
sub.description:
Whitebeard and his crew dock at one of the ports in the Land of Wano with their broken ship and the news excites Oden. He runs to the port and asks Whitebeard to let him get on board the ship but the request is rejected. When the ship`s repairs are complete, Whitebeard tries to sneak out of the country, but he finds Oden tagging along.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Whitebeard`s Little Brother! Oden`s Great Adventure!
sub.description:
Oden’s journey finally begins. He is in awe of all the things that he has never seen before. And for the first time in his life, he becomes a wanted person and makes the headlines which catches the eye of a high-profile figure. Meanwhile he becomes romantically involved with Toki and they have a child together.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Crossing Swords! Roger and Whitebeard!
sub.description:
In the Land of Wano, the Shogun Sukiyaki falls critically ill and names Orochi proxy Shogun until Oden returns in case he dies. Meanwhile, Whitebeard’s ship carrying Oden docks at some island overseas, unaware that Gold Roger and his clan are fighting against the Navy on the other side of the island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Roger`s Wish! A New Journey!
sub.description:
Roger is amazed when he finds out that Oden can read the script on the Ponegliff since he believes it will guide him to the last, undiscovered island where no man has ever been. Roger begs Whitebeard for permission to take Oden with him on a one-year journey. But Oden gives it some thought and speaks his mind as well!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Devoting His Life! Roger`s Adventure!
sub.description:
Singing out loud, the Roger Pirates continue on with their journey. They soar up to the island above the clouds and go down into the deep sea to get to the island at the sea bottom. Oden deciphers the Ponegliffs on those islands for Roger who believes those inscriptions will tell them the location of the last island on the Grand Line.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The King of the Pirates Is Born! Arriving at the Last Island!
sub.description:
Oden and the Roger Pirates head for the Land of Wano to obtain a copy of the Road Ponegliff. Oden sees Kin’emon and the others for the first time in years, but he immediately returns to the sea leaving his wife and children behind. Then, after stopping by at the Mokomo Dukedom and getting a copy of the last Road Ponegliff, the Roger Pirates finally make it to the last island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the Land of Wano! The Roger Pirates Disband!
sub.description:
After reaching Laugh Tale, Roger declares the disbanding of his pirate group and disembarks first. Oden gets dropped off at the Land of Wano and reunites with his family and retainers. Later, he hears that Orochi took over the country with the help of a strong pirate named Kaido after the Shogun Sukiyaki’s death and becomes enraged by stories of his tyrannical acts.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sad News! The Opening of the Great Pirate Era!
sub.description:
Enraged by Orochi’s tyrannical acts, Oden raids his castle in the Flower Capital and points his sword at Orochi. However, hours later, people who were waiting for Oden to come out after defeating Orochi see the unexpected. Meanwhile, the King of the Pirates Roger’s execution and last words are printed in newspapers and spread across the world.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Raid! Oden and the Akazaya Nine!
sub.description:
Oden keeps dancing naked in the Flower Capital and losing all the trust of the people. One day, Orochi comes to Kuri and reveals his evil plan for the Land of Wano as well as his brutalities against the country’s mobster and Oden’s friend, Hyogoro and his wife. Despairing and in a rage, Oden finally decides to take down Orochi’s supporter, Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The End of the Battle! Oden vs. Kaido!
sub.description:
Kaido comes to the mainland along with his troops to fight against Oden and the Akazaya samurai who were on their way to raid Kaido’s mansion. Even though Oden’s group are unprepared and outnumbered, they fight hard to save the future of the Land of Wano.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Boiled to Death! Oden`s One-hour Struggle!
sub.description:
Oden and the Akazaya members are sentenced to death by boiling in a pot. Oden asks for a chance to survive which is accepted by Kaido. Then, Oden enters the boiling pot holding his retainers over his head. Shinobu watches from among the spectators and reveals what Oden had been doing to save the country, to the surprise of the citizens.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Oden Wouldn`t Be Oden If It Wasn`t Boiled!
sub.description:
As Oden continues trying to survive in the boiling pot holding his retainers over his head, people learn the truth from Shinobu and get shocked.
At the same time, Oden tells his retainers the importance of opening the borders of the Land of Wano. Time ticks down for Oden and his clan’s freedom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Castle on Fire! The Fate of the Kozuki Clan!
sub.description:
As Kin’emon and the others run to Oden Castle to save Oden’s family, the castle is set on fire and Kaido attacks Toki and her children. Leaving Momonosuke to Kin’emon and Hiyori to Kawamatsu, Toki appears in front of the desperate people of the Land of Wano and gives a prophecy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Back to the Present Day! 20 Years Later!
sub.description:
After 20 years since Oden Castle burned down, Oden’s surviving retainers are working hard separately at their own missions, believing in Toki’s prophecy. The day of the Fire Festival has finally come and the whole army is now getting ready to head for Onigashima to raid Kaido!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Sea Is for Pirates! Raid! To Onigashima!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and thousands of allies who were supposed to be there are nowhere to be found, but Kin’emon and the others decide to set sail to the stormy sea in a small boat. Kaido’s army that appears out of nowhere and a betrayal drive the Akazaya members into a corner.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Worst Generation Charges In! The Battle of the Stormy Sea!
sub.description:
Luffy, Law, and Kid join the Akazaya samurai and begin to fight Kaido’s army. The three rivals from the Worst Generation compete with each other as they attack the enemy fleet with their ultimate skills. When it seems like they gain upper hand in the battle, another strong enemy appears to help Kaido’s army.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Good Luck?! Leader Kin`emon`s Plot!
sub.description:
The Akazaya members are surprised by help from their old mate and Kin’emon notices he made a big mistake which has luckily saved all his allies. As their battle against Kaido’s army heats up, the cornered Kanjuro makes a stunning move.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Tearful Promise! The Kidnapped Momonosuke!
sub.description:
Swept away by Kanjuro, Momonosuke remembers his father, tries to rise above his fear, and speak to his allies. Luffy and the others start heading for Onigashima, but Kaido’s army gets in their way again with a formidable weapon. However, a surprising figure comes to help the cornered Straw Hats.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A New Member! `First Son of the Sea` Jimbei!
sub.description:
Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat crew are excited to see Jimbei again and welcome him as a new member. Meanwhile, Law and the Akazaya members strategize on how to enter Onigashima and attack Kaido. As the Straw Hats approach the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima, they are attacked out of the blue.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Kaido`s Trump Card! The Tobi Roppo Appear!
sub.description:
To Law and the others’ surprise, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats attack the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima. Meanwhile, Kaido and Orochi are having a big banquet on the island where Kaido’s formidable subordinates are also called in.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Samurai Warriors` Earnestness! The Straw Hats Land at Onigashima!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and the samurai warriors finally reach Onigashima! Before they set out for the castle as they planned, the samurai warriors use surprising but determined tactics to cut off their retreat which leave the Straw Hats in shock.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Goes Out of Control?! Sneaking into Kaido`s Banquet!
sub.description:
Eustass Kid and his clan start heading for Kaido`s castle head on waving Luffy off. Luffy and Zoro go after them to stop them from causing trouble, but they happen to step into Kaido’s banquet. Meanwhile, Kanjuro loses his way to Kaido in underground passages with Momonosuke who he kidnapped in tow.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Thinking of Otama! Luffy`s Furious Strike!
sub.description:
Luffy and Zoro each witness Kaido’s subordinates waste food at the banquet and make fun of the poor people in the Land of Wano. Thinking of Otama, a small girl who liked red-bean soup so much, both Luffy and Zoro become infuriated and create turmoil.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fighting Music! An Ability That Harms Luffy!
sub.description:
After making a scene at the Golden Festival, Luffy and Zoro try to get away, but Queen announces his subordinates that anyone who catches them will be rewarded with a position in the Tobi Roppo. Scratchmen Apoo stands Luffy and Zoro’s way and with his ability to use music as a weapon, he launches unpredictable attacks which corner Luffy and Zoro.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: His Dream Broken?! The Trap That Lures Sanji!
sub.description:
Haccha, a supergiant Number, joins in and the pursuit of Luffy and the others becomes even more intense. Meanwhile, Kin’emon changes his strategy and his group tries to infiltrate the castle from its side, but there is an unexpected change of the floor plan which coincidentally makes Sanji excited.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!
sub.description:
Luffy, Law, Kin’emon, and all the others are trying to infiltrate Kaido’s castle from all sides. Meanwhile, Big Mom’s children are climbing up the waterfall towards Onigashima again, but this time, Marco the Phoenix appears from nowhere and stands in their way!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Pact Between Men! The Fierce Fighting of Brachio Tank!
sub.description:
The furious Big Mom chases Brachio Tank driven by Chopper and Usopp, but they bravely fight back! Meanwhile, Kanjuro takes the battered and bruised Momonosuke to Kaido and Orochi, then breaks the news to them about Oden’s retainers who were thought to be dead.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Thunder Bagua! Here Comes Kaido`s Son!
sub.description:
Luffy runs into Ulti and Page One, members of the Tobi Roppo from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Hearing that he aims to become the King of the Pirates, the brother and sister duo become infuriated and turn themselves into massive beasts. When Luffy is driven into a corner, someone wearing a demon mask appears and whisks him away.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Enemy or Ally? Luffy and Yamato!
sub.description:
Evading Ulti and Page One, strong members of the Tobi Roppo, Luffy tries to find out what Kaido’s son Yamato’s motive is. However, the two get in a fight. Taking Luffy’s punishing attacks, Yamato remembers someone he fought against in the past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Desire to Be Oden! Yamato`s Dream!
sub.description:
The Akazaya members who were on board Law’s Polar Tang finally reach Onigashima and see someone who they didn’t expect. Kaido’s son Yamato starts telling his story to Luffy, shares his passion, and reveals what’s behind his mask!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Explosive?! The Handcuffs That Shackle Yamato`s Freedom!
sub.description:
At the back entrance of Onigashima, the Akazaya members try to get inside the gate, but they’re blocked by their former colleague Kanjuro. Meanwhile, as Kaido’s son Yamato shows Luffy the handcuffs that have restricted his freedom for years, they hear Kaido making a speech on his grand plan.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Akazaya Face-off! Kikunojo vs. Kanjuro!
sub.description:
Kaido’s plan to obtain the great treasure infuriates Orochi, but his unexpected violent move silences everyone. Meanwhile at the back entrance of Onigashima, Kikunojo squares off against Kanjuro and gets into an emotional fight with her former colleague.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Raid! Inheriting Oden`s Will
sub.description:
The Akazaya members start charging towards Kaido from the back of Onigashima. Meanwhile, at the Performance Floor, Kaido closes in on Momonosuke shivering in terror and asks him the ultimate question which will determine his fate.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Onigashima in Tumult! Luffy`s All-Out War Begins!
sub.description:
The Akazaya members deliver a crushing blow to Kaido. Luffy and Yamato try to back them up, but Ulti stands in their way and Big Mom spots Luffy. Meanwhile, Nami and Carrot free themselves from their enemies and move on to take back Zeus!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Battle Under the Moon! The Berserker, Sulong the Moon Lion!
sub.description:
The Animal Kingdom Pirates gasp with surprise to see thousands of samurai warriors coming into the castle. In his dragon form, Kaido goes outside to fight the Akazaya members under the moon. However, the Akazaya members have secret weapons to use against him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zeus` Treason?! The Cornered Nami!
sub.description:
Shinobu tries to rescue the weakened Momonosuke but is found by King and attacked. On the other hand, Nami takes back Zeus from Big Mom and runs away but loses him again and gets chased by Zeus who is ordered to kill to her by Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I`ll Protect You! Yamato Meets Momonosuke!
sub.description:
Franky faces Big Mom with the help of Robin and Jimbei, but the Numbers come interrupting their battle. One of them holds Brachio Tank with Usopp and Chopper inside in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato, the self-proclaimed Oden, finally meets his son Momonosuke.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Overwhelming Strength! The Straw Hats Come Together!
sub.description:
As the Minks struggle with a poor hand against the Gifters, Kin’emon tries to assist them, but Dogstorm and Cat Viper stop him and start fighting for the other Minks! Meanwhile, Luffy and Zoro try to get to the rooftop to help Kin’emon and the others, but Queen and King get in their way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen!
sub.description:
Who’s-Who invites Drake and Hawkins to a plot to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down. As Luffy charges towards them, someone unexpected comes in to help.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A New Rivalry! Nami and Ulti!
sub.description:
Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Usopp’s practical joke pushes Nami into confronting Ulti, who is infuriated since her brother got attacked.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Heroic Blade! Akazaya vs. Kaido, Again Once More!
sub.description:
Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into ogre-like monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner. However, Kaido stands up for his subordinate.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Inherited Technique! Unleashing Oden`s Secret Swordplay!
sub.description:
While Luffy is hurrying to the rooftop and Yamato is trying to catch up to Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazaya members finally face off against Kaido. Hearing Kaido jeering at them for being weak, the samurai retainers attack him relentlessly, remembering the day Oden told them to master his sword skill.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Power of "Ice Oni"! A New Version of the Plague Rounds!
sub.description:
Queen, the Lead Performer, blazes away at samurai on the Performance Floor with the special version of the Plague Rounds, which turns them into hideous ogres that corner Zoro and Drake. Meanwhile, Luffy and Sanji, who are on their way to the rooftop, run into another Headliner with a special ability.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Won`t Forgive Him! Chopper`s Determination!
sub.description:
King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Shinobu tries to protect him, but they are cornered by one of the strong Lead Performers from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Meanwhile, seeing people suffering from Queen’s Plague Rounds, Chopper is determined to save everyone.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zoro`s Pursuit! Ice Oni Tag!
sub.description:
Yamato fights Sasaki and the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division to protect Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game which involves the antibody for the virus.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Nami Surrenders?! Ulti`s Fierce Headbutt!
sub.description:
Ulti and Page One of the Tobi Roppo chase Nami and Usopp, after being infuriated by their attack as well as Luffy’s declaration of becoming the King of the Pirates. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sasaki`s Onslaught! Armored Division vs. Yamato!
sub.description:
Carrot and Wanda step in to help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights a fierce battle against the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division led by Sasaki, while protecting Shinobu and Momonosuke.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper`s Fire Trick!
sub.description:
Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni, while Chopper is trying to figure out how to fight the virus. In the castle, Luffy, Jimbei, and Sanji are climbing up the stairs to reach the rooftop where the Akazaya members’ tough battle against Kaido rages on.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: It`s Not Okay! The Spider Lures Sanji!
sub.description:
Sanji hears a woman’s scream for help and dashes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it’s a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. Meanwhile, Luffy and Jimbei who are trying to reach the rooftop get help from the unexpected.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
sub.description:
While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni. The members of the Tobi Roppo continue to give the Straw Hats a hard time while their former member helps Zoro.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Yamato`s Past! The Man Who Came for an Emperor of the Sea!
sub.description:
Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once confronted a man, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido’s head. His name was Ace. The two of them engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Marco`s Tears! The Bond of the Whitebeard Pirates!
sub.description:
The formidable Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates stand in Zoro’s way as he tries to get to the rooftop. Marco sees his late comrade in Zoro’s determination and tries to pave the way for him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
sub.description:
Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains!
sub.description:
Luffy’s strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong ones he’s ever met. On the other hand, Luffy, Law, and Kid keep quarreling amongst themselves. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria in what he calls “heaven.”
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
sub.description:
Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro, and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Kaido Laughs! The Emperors of the Sea vs. the New Generation!
sub.description:
Luffy pummels Kaido with his well-trained Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way and Kid and Killer also try to finish Kaido off.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Otama`s Secret Plan! Operation Kibi Dango!
sub.description:
After watching the Straw Hats’ departure to Onigashima, Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she’s here on Onigashima, it’s time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sanji`s Scream! An SOS Echoes over the Island!
sub.description:
Sanji is captured and tortured by the merciless Black Maria. She names the terms of his release: to turn over one of his crewmates. He hesitates but has no other option. After much distress, he makes a move that surprises everyone.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Spank Strikes! Sanji`s Woman-trouble!
sub.description:
Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji along with Brook, and faces Black Maria, who is trying to keep Sanji as her pet. Meanwhile, Yamato, Momonosuke, and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy, and they find themselves on the run again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
sub.description:
Chopper works hard to make the cure for Ice Oni, even though he is turning into one himself. Meanwhile, the infected Boss Hyogoro the Flower regains his youth and fights fiercely to protect Chopper and the others.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: All Set! Chopperphage Nebulizer!
sub.description:
Seeing everyone turning into Ice Oni, there is nothing that the samurai warriors can do other than grieve. However, it wasn’t just them who were devastated by Queen’s raging virus. When their desperation and frustration peak, they hear a hopeful voice.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
sub.description:
The wounded Akazaya members are surprised to see Kozuki Oden alive. They were disappointed by their failure to take down Kaido, but now with their lord, they are filled with hope to face their sworn enemy again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors` Deadly Attack!
sub.description:
The Akazaya members run to save Momonosuke, but an unexpected contender stands in their way. Queen gets infuriated after Chopper ruined his plot and goes after him. Meanwhile, on the rooftop, Kaido and Big Mom unleashes a combination attack on Luffy and the others.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
sub.description:
The returned Orochi clashes the Akazaya members who are trying to save Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others are all covered in bruises, but they unite their strength and launch an attack.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Defend Luffy! Zoro and Law`s Sword Technique!
sub.description:
Even after Big Mom was pushed off of the island, Zoro and the others keep fighting the exhausting battle against Kaido. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack at the risk of his life.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
sub.description:
Luffy remembers how he was advised by his friends, how he was saved by his comrades, and the frustrations of being defeated. As Kaido mocks him to his face, the Color of the Supreme King Haki gushes out and they clash again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Faint Memory! Luffy and Red-Haired`s Daughter Uta!
sub.description:
A young Luffy who has been dreaming about getting out of Windmill Village one day to accomplish something great meets a young girl named Uta who came along with Shanks and the Red-Hair Pirates calling herself the musician of the pirate group. 
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Pledge for the New Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
sub.description:
Luffy and Uta run across Windmill Village, compete with each other, and share their dreams with each other. They also pledge to build a new genesis for everyone to live happily. However, one day, the unexpected happens. 
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Nami Screams - A Deadly Death Race!
sub.description:
Luffy and Kaido who have both infused themselves with the Color of the Supreme King clash! Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are running from Page One to get to the Performance Floor, but they bump into another tough enemy, Big Mom.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: The Dawn of the Land of Wano - The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
sub.description:
Kin’emon and the Akazaya members are rushing to help Momonosuke and everyone else while Yamato leaves Momonosuke and Shinobu in a hide-out to lure away their enemies. At the same time, Ulti tries to avenge her brother against Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Supreme King
sub.description:
Sanji is forced to run with Zoro on his shoulder. Meanwhile, Nami bravely stands up against Ulti and Big Mom. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido finally comes to an end.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy, Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
sub.description:
Luffy is pushed off the rooftop by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zeus intervenes in a fight between Big Mom and Nami’s group and stands up for the one who he wants to save. On the Performance Floor, Chopper is in a fierce battle against Queen.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Animal Kingdom Pirates Trample Down! The End of the Kozuki Clan!
sub.description:
While the Straw Hats and their allies are all having a hard time, they are shocked by the news that Luffy lost to Kaido. At the same time, Kanjuro closes in on Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fight Against the Dark Night - The Commander-in-Chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off
sub.description:
Like all the other samurai, Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy’s loss and Queen doesn’t miss the chance to finish him off! Meanwhile, Kin’emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke and that motivates Momonosuke to rise up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance`s Counterattack Begins!
sub.description:
Momonosuke and Shinobu face Kaido while Kid and Law challenge Big Mom. Meanwhile, Nami, heading towards the stage on the Performance Floor along with Usopp and Tama, hears a strange voice.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Nami`s Lethal Attack! Otama`s Desperate Challenge!
sub.description:
Nami strikes a thunder blast to clear the way to the stage on the Performance Floor. However, the elite corps of the Gifters shows up to crush their inferior opponents. Upset but unbroken, Otama stands up to give a command!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
sub.description:
Hearing Otama’s command, the Gifters side with the samurai and upset the Tobi Roppo and others! Chopper starts to take care of Zoro while suffering from the side effect of the enhanced Rumble Ball. Meanwhile, Jimbei gets stunned by Who’s-Who’s story.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: The Pride of a Helmsman - The Enraged Jimbei!
sub.description:
Who’s-Who expresses fierce resentment toward Luffy and Jimbei fights back out of his loyalty to Luffy. As Who’s-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men and that sparks Jimbei’s outrage.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
sub.description:
To cut ties with Kaido, Yamato unleashes his true power. Meanwhile, Queen repeatedly attacks Sanji with his power as a cyborg, and Sasaki in his Man-Beast Form launches tricky attacks on Franky and drives him into a corner.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: The Predator`s Trap - Black Maria`s Temptation
sub.description:
Kaido tries to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of the Land of Wano and rule the country with the special power he obtained by accident. Meanwhile, Saul, Professor Clover, and Robin’s mother Olvia suddenly appear in front of her.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Slash the Nightmare - Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
sub.description:
In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Clutch! A Demon Incarnate, Robin!
sub.description:
Black Maria torments Robin both physically and spiritually. As she burns in hellfire, Robin remembers the people who gave her a hard time and the people who supported her, and she as Demon Child shows what she is really capable of.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!
sub.description:
Killer is shocked to find out who Hawkins’ straw doll he slashed represents. Meanwhile, Sanji who is in a hard battle against Queen and King sees enemy brutes going after the injured Zoro, and no one else is there to save him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
sub.description:
Zoro gets back on his feet and along with Sanji, confronts King and Queen, the Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Watching Zoro fight, Hyogoro and Kawamatsu remember someone from way back.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated
sub.description:
Dogstorm confronts his sworn enemy who destroyed his country. Meanwhile, Cat Viper faces Perospero who is responsible for Pedro’s death. At Tokage Port, Momonosuke roars with his determined eyes.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen`s Pledge
sub.description:
The battle between Kaido and Yamato gets intense. Backed into a corner, Yamato remembers three great swordsmen who he met when he was a child. Their stunning choice for the future of the Land of Wano encourages Yamato.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts
sub.description:
Luffy amps up the reluctant Momonosuke, who is afraid of heights, in his giant pink dragon form, to fly and take him to Onigashima in the sky. Meanwhile, Yamato, in a hard battle against Kaido, vows to survive until Luffy returns.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke`s Determination!
sub.description:
Momonosuke faces Kaido once again trembling in fear. However, with Luffy’s encouragement, he bravely steps up and shows his dragon fangs remembering what he had to go through because of Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy`s Fist Roars in the Sky
sub.description:
Asked to stop Onigashima by Luffy, Momonosuke once again gets cold feet, but this time, he has a reliable ally who can teach him how to fly. The clash between Luffy and Kaido shakes up the sky and enables Dogstorm and Cat Viper to exert all their strength.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
sub.description:
Realizing Onigashima’s impending threat, imperiling everyone’s life, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation. Meanwhile, Sanji and Zoro are both in a deadly battle against Queen and King.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Sanji`s Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!
sub.description:
Queen’s unforeseen move stuns everyone on the Performance Floor. And then, he goes on to utilize another special technique which can break every bone in Sanji’s body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Death to Your Partner! Killer`s Deadly Gamble
sub.description:
Killer tries to figure out how to fight against Hawkins whose power enables him to transfer damage against him to Kid. Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from. Killer takes a chance with Kid’s life on the line.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
sub.description:
Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin’emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: A Countercharge! Law and Kid`s Return-Attack Combination
sub.description:
Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro`s Oath
sub.description:
Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi`s Evil Clutches Close In
sub.description:
Kazenbo, the giant specter of fire symbolizing the burning wrath of the Kurozumi Clan, rampages through the castle creating panic among both the Animal Kingdom Pirates and the samurai. Orochi who is watching in excitement suddenly hears a sound that brings back memories.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zoro Faces Adversity - A Monster! King the Wildfire
sub.description:
Zoro is facing a hard fight against King who seems invincible. Even one of Zoro’s deadliest attacks doesn’t leave a scratch on him. On top of that, one of Zoro’s swords goes out of control and gets in his way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Secret of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
sub.description:
Zoro still can’t gain control of Enma which keeps extracting his Haki. Backed into a corner by the formidable King, Zoro remembers the encounter with an old man in his hometown when he was a child.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen
sub.description:
Queen’s formidable attacks remind Sanji of his family. Annoyed by Queen’s provocations, Sanji remembers a young woman mysteriously getting hurt in front of him and realizes what happened at that time, which lights a fire within him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Three-Sword Style of the Supreme King! Zoro vs. King
sub.description:
Zoro tries to figure out a way to damage King. Meanwhile, King remembers when he first met his captain Kaido and declares that his captain is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Is on the Move! A Turning Point to a New Era!
sub.description:
Usopp finds Kin’emon’s upper body and the heavily wounded Kiku. However, they are surrounded by the Gifters and can’t find a way out. Seeing the samurai giving up hope, Usopp remembers his determination.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy
sub.description:
In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is about to end. On Onigashima, the battle between Luffy and Kaido is getting even more intense. However, Kaido who is excited about having a strong opponent starts drinking too much.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire Up, the Will of the New Generation!
sub.description:
With the ongoing battles in various parts of Onigashima, everyone is reaching their limits. In the face of Big Mom, Law and Kid are exhausted and deeply wounded. Mocking them, Big Mom tries to head for the rooftop.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Here Comes the Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism
sub.description:
Big Mom’s strong life force discourages Law and Kid. Law tells Kid that he only has enough energy for one last strike. However, a monster Big Mom summons puts the two in even more of a bind.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
sub.description:
Kid’s all-out deadly attack and Law’s tactical action leave Big Mom in the lurch. Then she remembers what Roger said in the past and wonders if the treasure he mentioned is out there after all.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!
sub.description:
Kaido mourns Big Mom’s defeat and remembers the day he met her for the first time. Meanwhile, backed into a corner, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: There Is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido
sub.description:
On orders from the Five Elders, the CP-0 agent Guernica tries to get to Luffy, but Drake stands in his way. Meanwhile, Luffy who only has very little energy left uses his last Gear Four to emancipate the people of the Land of Wano from Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
sub.description:
The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. Kaido comes down and tells everyone that Luffy has been defeated and the Land of Wano is finished. Momonosuke and Yamato argue over whether they should still continue fighting.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy`s Peak - Attained! Gear Five
sub.description:
As Luffy’s heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
sub.description:
Bouncing on the ground and becoming a giant, Luffy enjoys his new, bizarre power while Kaido is bewildered and can’t make sense of it. Meanwhile, Kid, Law, and Luffy’s other allies continue the fight down below against flames and enemies alike, waiting for Luffy to emerge victorious.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: No Way Out! A Hellish Scene on Onigashima
sub.description:
Now the whole Onigashima is ablaze. Chopper reunites with Nami while Sanji and the others are each trying to escape from the flames. However, Raizo who harbors a great regret from his past stands up to the fire with the help of Jimbei.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Trust Momo - Luffy`s Final Powerful Technique!
sub.description:
Momonosuke struggles to create Flame Clouds to sustain Onigashima which is in free fall. In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is ending with people flying their Sky Boats in the air. To fulfill the promise to free the Land of Wano, Luffy inflates his fist to strike Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: 20 Years` Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano
sub.description:
When Oden died 20 years ago, Orochi took over the Land of Wano. People were separated from their loved ones, forced into labor, and starved. Now they pray that Kaido will vanish as Luffy’s battle against him reaches a climax.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Curtain Falls! The Winner, Straw Hat Luffy!
sub.description:
The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido. Meanwhile, Momonosuke informs Zunesha of a major decision that he made. However, when Yamato calls on the Animal Kingdom Pirates to stop fighting, the earth trembles.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke
sub.description:
The people of the Flower Capital get flustered when Kin’emon and the other Akazaya samurai who were supposed to be dead appear from the smoke. However, the last one who walks out of the smoke, and what he says, confuses the people even more.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Morning Comes! Luffy and the Others Rest!
sub.description:
The Land of Wano is in a celebratory mood now that the years of tyranny are over. However, Yamato is holding back his hunger alone until Hiyori arrives with the news he was waiting for. Meanwhile, some unknown figure approaches the Land of Wano.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!
sub.description:
The news of the defeat of the Emperors of the Sea spreads across the world. Luffy enjoys the banquet but just as he is about to make a toast, an enraged Kid comes in to strike him. The reason behind his action surprises Luffy
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!
sub.description:
As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired`s Imperial Rage
sub.description:
Navy Admiral Ryokugyu keeps up a savage assault against the Akazaya samurai who are still recovering from the last battle. Momonosuke tries to defend the Land of Wano with all his might, but he gets driven into a corner.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild
sub.description:
Momonosuke and Hiyori are happy to see their grandfather who was supposed to be dead and the Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about Pluton the Ancient Weapon. Meanwhile, Momonosuke is kept busy in his role as the new Shogun.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats
sub.description:
An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
sub.description:
Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
sub.description:
Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Bonney`s Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
sub.description:
While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
sub.description:
The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Mystery Deepens! Egghead Labophase
sub.description:
The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they`ve never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
sub.description:
Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they’re in battle, some of Vegapunk’s Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
sub.description:
Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
sub.description:
Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
sub.description:
Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
sub.description:
CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
sub.description:
Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim`s Powers!
sub.description:
Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
sub.description:
Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Turn Back My Father! Bonney`s Futile Wish!
sub.description:
CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim`s All-out Attack!
sub.description:
The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy!
sub.description:
Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats’ surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they’re stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Trouble Occurs! Seek Dr. Vegapunk!
sub.description:
CP-0 takes control of the Fabriophase but gets attacked by an unknown force. Meanwhile, in the Labophase, the Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk’s Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory
sub.description:
Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Incomprehensible! The Seraphim`s Rebellion!
sub.description:
The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
sub.description:
Lucci and Kaku from CP0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and CP0 relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the Seraphim keep getting back up. Then, Zoro notices that the Seraphim remind him of someone who he fought before. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk Stella might be.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind`s Ambition!
sub.description:
Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Clash! Shanks vs. Eustass Kid
sub.description:
