Nami`s heartbreaking past - and Luffy`s epic battle with Arlong - are recalled in this flashback to the early days of the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Parting Builds a Man's Character! Sanji and Chopper!
dub.description:
A flashback sheds light on how Sanji came to join the crew, and Chopper`s backstory is revealed through memories of a visit to a snow-covered island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Everything is for Her Friends! Robin in the Darkness!
dub.description:
A flashback reveals Robin`s motives for cooperating with CP9, Nami`s shocking discovery about the archaeologist`s past, and Luffy`s determination to save his friend!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: I'm Not Gonna Hand Over the Blueprints! Franky's Decision!
dub.description:
Franky stands up to Spandam by destroying what the madman desires most, and the sound of the sea train spurs the Straw Hats to make a daring leap of faith!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Obtain the 5 Keys! The Straw Hat Pirates vs. CP9!
dub.description:
Luffy races to rescue Robin while the rest of the Straw Hats set off in search of the five keys needed to unlock the archaeologist!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Devil Fruit Powers! Kaku and Jabra Transform!
dub.description:
While Usopp and Zoro go head-to-head with a couple of animal assassins, Sanji teaches the most beautiful member of CP9 the secrets of making good tea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: I Won't Kick Even If It Costs Me My Life! Sanji's Chivalry!
dub.description:
Luffy runs into trouble trying to sail his way to Robin, Usopp and Zoro end up handcuffed together, and Sanji`s inability to kick a women may lead to serious injury!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Fukurou's Miscalculation! My Cola is the Water of Life!
dub.description:
Chimney and Gombe show Luffy the secret passage that leads to Robin, and Franky puts on a display of raw punching power thanks to a few bottles of cola!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Zoro Busts Out a New Technique! The Sword's Name is Sniperking?
dub.description:
While Franky`s brawl spills into the ocean, Sogeking and Zoro attempt to overcome their handcuffs by outsmarting their opponents!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Uncontrollable! Chopper's Forbidden Rumble!
dub.description:
Determined not to be defeated by the heinous hair of a devious lion, Chopper risks life and limb by summoning the power of his Rumble Ball for a third time!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Boss Luffy Returns! Is It a Dream or Reality? Lottery Ruckus!
dub.description:
Travel back to ancient Japan for a madcap adventure starring the Straw Hats, some old friends and enemies, and a camel that eats lottery tickets!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Big Rice Cake Tossing Race at the Castle! Red Nose's Plot!
dub.description:
The madcap throwback continues as Luffy and the gang - along with a crowd of characters from the Alabasta arc - competes for a priceless treasure hidden inside a tasty snack!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Bubble Master Kalifa! The Soap Trap Closes in on Nami!
dub.description:
Nami battles a bathing beauty and her lethal bubbles, Chopper unleashes his inner beast, and Luffy inches ever closer to catching up with Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Resounding Bad News! The Buster Call Invoked!
dub.description:
Franky has a painful encounter with monster Chopper, and Nami gets scrubbed too clean to fight! Meanwhile, Spandam accidentally invokes the deadly Buster Call!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Five Namis? Nami Strikes Back With Mirages!
dub.description:
Zoro uses Usopp as a decoy in his battle with the beasts, and Nami discovers the secret that could be the key to survival in her brawl with the bathing beauty!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Nami's Decision! Fire at the Out-Of-Control Chopper!
dub.description:
Franky and Nami come up with a plan to stop Chopper`s rampage, but it could prove deadly to the not-so-little reindeer. Usopp and Zoro are thrilled to finally be free of each other!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Hunter Sanji Makes An Entrance? Elegy for a Lying Wolf!
dub.description:
Usopp`s ill-advised attempt at bravery threatens to get him killed, but a familiar foot spares the sniper`s life. Luffy struggles to even strike a formidable foe, and Franky races to deliver some very important keys!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Fiery Kicks! Sanji's Full Course of Foot Techniques!
dub.description:
Sanji evens the playing field in his CP9 slugfest by introducing his wolfish opponent to the burning power of the devil`s leg!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Fierce Sword Attacks! Zoro vs. Kaku, Powerful Sword Fighting Showdown!
dub.description:
Zoro finally lands a blow against the killer giraffe, but Luffy still can`t find a way to break through against Lucci! Can Frank reach Robin before it`s too late!?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Demon God Zoro! An Incarnation Of Asura Born From Fighting Spirit!
dub.description:
Zoro unleashes a demonic nine sword fighting style on his giraffe opponent, Luffy buys time for Franky by ascending to second gear, and Robin refuses to give up hope of being rescued!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Spandam Frightened! The Hero on the Tower of Law!
dub.description:
Spandam cruely drags Robin ever closer to the gates of justice, but the battle takes a turn for the better when the Sniper King makes a surprise appearance!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Robin Freed! Luffy vs. Lucci, Showdown Between Leaders!
dub.description:
Luffy`s battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man`s second gear, and the Spandam`s thoughtless Buster Call begins with a brutal barrage of cannon balls.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Boss Luffy is the Culprit? Track Down the Missing Great Cherry Tree!
dub.description:
When an ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time, Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji track down the culprit in an attempt to save a village`s annual festival!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: I Can't Protect Anyone Unless I Win! Third Gear Activated!
dub.description:
Nami, Sanji, Usopp, Zoro, and company find themselves trapped in to tunnel filled with rapidly rising water. Meanwhile, Luffy musters the strength for one last stand in his battle with Lucci.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Shivering Past! Dark Justice and Rob Lucci!
dub.description:
Flashback to the dark past of Rob Lucci as the young boy learns to dispense a cold, cruel, and brutal brand of justice. Back in real time, Luffy`s battle with Lucci threatens to destroy the navy fleet.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Mysterious Mermaid Appears? As Consciousness Fades Away...
dub.description:
Luffy`s gigantic attack on Lucci takes a devastating toll on his body, Robin rejoins the fight, and the rest of the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Cannon Fire Sinks the Island! Franky's Lamentation!
dub.description:
Thanks to a little help from what appears to be a mermaid, the Straw Hats find themselves reunited aboard an escape vessel, but the fate of Luffy and the Franky Family is yet to be determined!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Wait for Luffy! Mortal Combat on the Bridge of Hesitation!
dub.description:
Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point in his battle with Lucci, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines until their captain returns - if he ever does.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Fists Full of Emotion! Luffy Unleashes Gatling with All His Might!
dub.description:
Luffy lies battered and badly beaten, but Usopp`s desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final, furious attack on Rob Lucci!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: From the Sea, a Friend Arrives! The Straw Hats Share the Strongest Bond!
dub.description:
With their leader crippled by exhaustion and their escape ship destroyed, the Straw Hats find themselves with only one treacherous option: throwing themselves into the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Everyone Makes a Great Escape! The Road to Victory is for the Pirates!
dub.description:
The Straw Hats are rescued by the unexpected arrival of a dear old friend, but they`ll have to avoid a barrage of deadly cannonballs in order to survive!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Peace Interrupted! A Navy Vice Admiral with a Fist of Love!
dub.description:
The Straw Hats get some much needed rest and relaxation, Franky makes a big announcement, and Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Strongest Family? Luffy's Father Revealed!
dub.description:
Luffy`s friends are shocked to learn that his grandpa is a marine hero, but that`s nothing compared to how surprised they`ll be by his father`s true identity!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Its Name Is The New World! The Fate of the Grand Line!
dub.description:
Luffy gets the chance to catch up with his old friend Coby, Nami does some serious snooping, and Robin is paid a chilling visit from a terrifying face from her past.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Shanks Makes a Move! The Linchpin to the Reckless Era!
dub.description:
Shanks visits Whitebeard with a serious request, Franky and Iceberg begin construction on a ship for the Straw Hats, and news spreads of the events at Enies Lobby.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Girl in Search of Her Yagara! Great Search in the City of Water!
dub.description:
Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Mothers are Strong! Zoro's Hectic Household Chores!
dub.description:
Zoro`s day takes a turn for the crazy when his search for a new sword is derailed by a couple of meddling orphans!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Sanji's Shock! Mysterious Old Man and His Super Yummy Cooking!
dub.description:
Sanji spends the day with a very old chef who teaches him the secret of packing amazing flavor into each and every dish!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Everyone Finally Has A Bounty! A Pirate Group Worth Over Six Hundred Million!
dub.description:
Franky and Iceberg stay up all night on a mission to finish a new ship for the Straw Hats, but the first light of day brings troubling news!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The King of Animals that Overlooks the Sea! The Dream Ship Magnificently Completed!
dub.description:
With their new ship completed, Luffy and the gang get ready to set sail, but first they`ll have to steal some underpants in order to secure the services of a shipwright!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Goodbye My Dear Underlings! Franky Departs!
dub.description:
A series of flashbacks to his younger days - and some painful persuasion by Robin - help Franky make the difficult decision to leave his friends and go to sea with the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Departing the City of Water! Usopp Mans Up and Brings Closure to the Duel!
dub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats are ready for their next adventure, but before they can move on they must await the return of Usopp - and avoid a barrage of cannon balls courtesy of Garp!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Wanted Posters Make It Around the World! Celebrations in Their Hometowns as the Ship Moves Forward!
dub.description:
The Straw Hats` new ship gets a name, and Franky shows off some of its special features as the gang goes sky high to avoid being sunk by the marines!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Most Heinous Power! Blackbeard's Darkness Attacks Ace!
dub.description:
Ace and Blackbeard go toe-to-toe in an epic clash of Devil Fruit powers that pits fire against darkness - and threatens to destroy an entire island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Mysterious Band of Pirates! Sunny and the Dangerous Trap!
dub.description:
Luffy and his mates cross paths with a ragged gang of sailors. The Straw Hats are quick to offer assistance, but their new friends may be up to no good!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Sunny in a Pinch! Roar, Secret Superspeed Mecha!
dub.description:
The Straw Hats discover that their fishermen friends are actually pirates, but Chopper refuses to abandon a very sick patient.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Dream Sinking in the New World! The Disillusioned Pirate, Puzzle!
dub.description:
The captain of the Phoenix Pirates loses his will to fight, and the Straw Hats get trapped in a field of icebergs by some figure skating bounty hunters!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Assassins Attack! The Great Battle on Ice Begins!
dub.description:
Nami and Franky take a spin in the shark sub, Usopp and Sanji have a run in with a flock of deadly penguins, and Puzzle can no longer hide the fact that he`s alive!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Staw Hat's Hard Battles! A Pirate Soul Risking It All for the Flag!
dub.description:
Robin is shocked by her encounter with an adorable bounty hunter, Franky and Nami get trapped in a frozen shark, and Luffy`s quest to recapture his flag sends him sinking toward the bottom of the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Hot Full Throttle! The Twin's Magnetic Power Drawing Near!
dub.description:
Luffy battles a set of magnetic twins, Sanji and Usopp fall victim to a pair of figure skating lovebirds, and Zoro has a drink with the man who stole the Straw Hat flag!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Mansion of Great Chaos! The Enraged Don and the Captured Crew!
dub.description:
Robin`s cola care package helps spring her friends from an icy prison, and Luffy`s bold words inspire a battered and beaten pirate to keep fighting!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Return of the Phoenix! The Dream of the Pirate Flag Sworn to a Friend!
dub.description:
While Luffy continues his battle with the magnetic twins, Chopper uses a rumble ball in his battle with a hockey player - and Robin tries to recover the Straw Hat flag!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Red Hot Decisive Battle! Luffy vs. The Scorching Don!
dub.description:
Luffy battles an opponent who`s too hot to handle, Robin gets attacked by a jungle, and Chopper makes a heroic dash for the Straw Hat flag!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Waiting in the New World! Farewell to the Brave Pirates!
dub.description:
Luffy`s red-hot battle with Papa threatens to destroy the entire icy island, and the rest of the Straw Hats need a little help from a former enemy to recover their flag!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Chopperman to the Rescue! Protect the TV Station by the Shore!
dub.description:
The most adorable hero the world has ever known - Chopperman - must battle a hideously evil villain to regain control of his favorite television station!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Plunging into the Devil's Sea! The Mysterious Skeleton Floating in the Fog!
dub.description:
While sailing through haunted waters, the Straw Hats encounter a ghost ship that`s home to a walking, talking skeleton!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Joy of Seeing People! The Gentleman Skeleton's True Identity!
dub.description:
The Straw Hats attempt to unravel the mystery of their new comrade, but the skeleton`s sad story is interrupted by a ghastly landing at the haunted island of Thriller Bark!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: One Unnatural Phenomenon After the Next! Disembarking on Thriller Bark!
dub.description:
After getting stranded at Thriller Bark, Chopper, Nami, and Usopp are chased by a three headed beast. Back on the boat, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats are terrorized by an unseen enemy!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Man Called a Genius! Hogback Makes His Appearance!
dub.description:
Chopper, Nami, and Usopp get scared out of their minds when they encounter a graveyard full of zombies! Meanwhile, the rest of the crew gets trapped in super creepy sea web!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Nami's in a Major Pinch! The Zombie Mansion and the Invisible Man!
dub.description:
An invisible man turns Nami`s bath time into a harrowing experience, and Usopp battles a hall full of haunted paintings with a handful of burning candles!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Zombie's Secret! Hogback's Nightmarish Laboratory!
dub.description:
While Usopp, Nami, and Chopper seek to unravel the secrets of the haunted mansion, Luffy and the gang do battle with an army of the undead!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: His Name is Moria! The Great Shadow-Seizing Pirate's Trap!
dub.description:
Luffy sets his sights on the shadowing-stealing monster known as Gecko Moria, and the zombie army prepares for a night attack led by their perverted, invisible leader!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Feast of the Zombie Song! The Night Raid's Bell is the Sound of Darkness!
dub.description:
Usopp, Chopper, and Nami get trapped in a coffin after being slashed by a zombie samurai. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats make short work of some haunted paintings!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Bunch of Animals? Perona's Wonder Garden!
dub.description:
After escaping from their coffin prison, Usopp, Chopper, and Nami do battle with a garden full of adorably dead zombie animals!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Vanishing Straw Hat Crew! A Mysterious Swordsman Appears!
dub.description:
An undead warthog sets her sights on Nami, Zorro and Sanji vanish without a trace, Franky and Robin battle an unbeatable army, and Luffy gets captured!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Chivalry Remains! The Traitorous Zombie Protects Nami!
dub.description:
A penguin zombie starts acting an awful lot like Sanji, Nami continues running for her life, and Robin and Franky buy some time by blowing up a bridge!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Appearing from the Sky! That Man Is the Humming Swordsman!
dub.description:
Nami gives love advice to a zombie, Luffy finds himself face-to-face with Gecko Moria, and Robin gets caught in spooky spider web. Things look bleak for the Straw Hats until their skeleton friend lends a hand!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Luffy's Emergency Situation! The Ultimate Shadow's Destination!
dub.description:
Brook strikes the final blow in his battle with the spider monkey, Gecko Moria`s devious plan is revealed, and Luffy`s escape attempt leads to the loss of something he can`t live without!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Warrior Known As the Devil!! The Moment of Oars' Revival
dub.description:
Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying zombies, and Gecko Moria reveals the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy`s shadow!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Awakening After 500 Years!! Oars Opens His Eyes!!
dub.description:
Luffy`s shadow is forced into the body of a monster, Usopp and Chopper get incinerated, and Nami is kidnapped by a zombie who wants to make her his wife!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Belief Worth Begging to Live for!! Brook Defends His Afro
dub.description:
Gecko Moria`s minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie brought to life by Luffy`s shadow. Meanwhile, Brook flashes back to a battle that almost cost him his beloved afro!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Man's Promise Never Dies!! To the Friend Waiting Under the Distant Sky
dub.description:
The freshly-revived trio of Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing, and Franky relates Brook`s story about a promise he made to a very special whale!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: I Swear to Go See Him! Brook and the Cape of Promise
dub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the heartbreaking story of Laboon the abandoned whale, and Brook`s battle with the zombie samurai reveals the reason behind his intense afro love!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Food, Nami and Shadows!! Luffy's Enraged Counterattack
dub.description:
Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince Brook to join the crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop Nami`s zombie wedding before it`s too late!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Usopp's the Strongest? Leave Anything Negative to Him
dub.description:
Usopp`s naturally negative personality makes him the only Straw Hat who stands a chance against Perona`s depressing army of ghosts, and Chopper prepares to do battle against his hero, Dr. Hogback!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The General Zombies Are Down in a Flash!! Oars Feels Like an Adventure!!
dub.description:
When Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai, Zoro steps in to help the skeleton get his shadow back. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares for a battle with Gecko Moria, and Sanji interrupts an undead wedding!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Blazing Knight Sanji!! Kick Down the Fake Wedding
dub.description:
Despite his furious attempts, Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria, but Sanji fares much better in his passionate attempt to defeat Nami`s beastly abductor!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Clear-Clear History? Sanji's Stolen Dream
dub.description:
Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible, Luffy finally manages to land a blow in his battle with Gecko Moria, and Usopp uses fire to ward off a zombie bear!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Save Me, Hero!! My Enemy Is the Immortal Princess
dub.description:
After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Perona Is Terrified!! Usopp and Untruthful Share the Same U
dub.description:
Usopp reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in his battle with Perona. Meanwhile, Luffy can`t lay a finger on Gecko Moria, and a zombie is less than gentlemanly in his battle with Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Slashes Dancing On the Rooftop!! Zoro vs. Ryuma's Showdown
dub.description:
While Franky and Brook watch in awe, Zorro and the zombie samurai wage a sword-slinging battle the likes of which the world has never seen before!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Chopper Is Furious!! Hogback's Evil Medical Practices
dub.description:
Chopper can no longer contain his fury over Dr. Hogback`s evil treatment of his zombie slaves. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares to face the zombie who`s wearing his shadow!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Oars Roars! Come Out, Straw Hat Crew
dub.description:
Moria`s mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy`s shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji`s eyes!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Luffy Is the Enemy! The Ultimate Zombie vs. The Straw Hat Crew
dub.description:
One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy`s got his sights set on Moria, but he`d better hurry if he wants to save his crew!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: You're Going Down, Absalom!! Nami's Lightning Attack of Friendship!!
dub.description:
Nami wakes up just in time to find out she’s about to marry a zombie, but the special occasion is interrupted by a very jealous warthog!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Knock Him Down!! Special Attack: Straw Hat Docking?
dub.description:
Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure, Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient, and a heroic team effort topples Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Silent Assault!! The Mysterious Visitor, Tyrant Kuma
dub.description:
Nami has a horrifying run in with Bartholomew Kuma, Perona becomes the latest lady to vanish, and Chopper, Franky, and Usopp team up to strike a blow against Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Oars + Moria! The Most Heinous Combination of Brains and Brawn
dub.description:
Kuma has an upsetting message for Moria, Luffy loses track of his intended target, and Zoro attempts to harness the power of a new sword during his battle with Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Secret Plan to Turn the Tables! Nightmare Luffy Makes His Appearance
dub.description:
Brook arrives with the salt needed to stop Oars, but the monster shows off some special new abilities. Deep in the forest, Luffy makes some new friends who help him power up!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Straw Hat Crew Gets Wiped Out! The Shadow-Shadow's Powers in Full Swing
dub.description:
Brook joins the fight as the Straw Hats valiantly try to hold off Oars and Moria until Luffy returns. Unfortunately, even their combined powers are no match for these evil enemies!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Incredible Battle Starts! Luffy vs Luffy
dub.description:
Oars and Moria ruthlessly pummel the badly beaten Straw Hats. The situation looks bleak until the shocking arrival of Nightmare Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The End of the Battle Is Nigh! Pound in the Finishing Move
dub.description:
After Luffy’s shadow power disappears, he’ll need help from rest of the Straw Hats to land a devastating finishing blow in his battle against Oars.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Our Bodies Vanish! The Morning Sun Shines On the Nightmarish Island!
dub.description:
Moria gobbles up every shadow in sight to power up for a final showdown with Luffy. Can the Straw Hats save the day before the dawn reduces them all to ashes!?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Not Out of Danger Yet! Orders to Annihilate the Straw Hat Crew
dub.description:
The battle between Luffy and Moria reaches its epic end, and the gargantuan shadow of the towering brute known as Kuma causes a panic on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: It Repels Everything! Kuma's Paw-Paw Power!
dub.description:
Kuma is ordered by the World Government to obliterate every living being on the island, but the Straw Hats – battered as they may be – refuse to go down without a fight!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Pain of My Crewmates Is My Pain! Zoro's Desperate Fight!
dub.description:
Zoro slashes against the Pacifista Kuma is meet with resistance harder than steel.  Unable to win with his swords he bets everything on a trade.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Promise from a Distant Day! The Pirates' Song and a Small Whale!
dub.description:
As the story of Kuma and Zoro is discussed, Brooks remembers back to when he was alive.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Brook's Past! A Sad Farewell with His Cheerful Comrade!
dub.description:
The continued story of Brooks the pirate and his friend Laboon.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Bink's Booze! The Song that Connects the Past with the Present!
dub.description:
Brooks shares the story of the final days of the Rumbar pirates and their final song.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A New Crewmate! The Musician, Humming Brook!
dub.description:
With a new official crewmate, the Straw Hat Pirates are ready to set sail.  Lola shares with Nami a unique item only available in the New World!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Slow-Slow Menace! 'Silver Fox' Foxy Returns!
dub.description:
While resting at a floating resort, Spa Island. The Straw Hat crew runs into a familiar old face and big trouble.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Great Scramble for Treasure! Collapse! Spa Island!
dub.description:
After Sayo is kidnapped, Luffy agrees to help Rina get her back.  His foolproof idea sends shockwaves through Spa Island.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Brook's Great Struggle! Is the Path to Becoming a True Comrade Rigorous?
dub.description:
Brook’s eagerness to become a trust comrade is backfiring immensely. What is causing his new anxiety and the crew survive much longer?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Arriving at Halfway Through the Grand Line! The Red Line
dub.description:
The Straw Hats have finally reached the red line with each member thinking back on the adventure.  Straws are picked to decided who will take the submarine to investigate the way to Fish-man Isle.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Hatred of the Straw Hat Crew: Enter Iron Mask Duval
dub.description:
After indirectly rescuing a unique pair, they beg the straw heats to help rescue a friend that has been kidnapped by Iron Mask Duval.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Fated Reunion! Save the Imprisoned Fish-man
dub.description:
Arriving at Duval’s base, it is obvious a trap, but when Camie’s friend is recognized as Hatchan, a former Arlong Pirate.  Luffy refuses to help so Camie and Pappgu attempt the rescue by themselves.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Tragedy! The Truth of the Unmasked Duval
dub.description:
The flying fish riders attack on the Straw Hats take place in the air and sea. Luffy is memorized by the flying fish as Zoro attempts to free Hatchan.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Explosion! The Sunny's Super Secret Weapon: Gaon Cannon
dub.description:
The secret of Duval is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Landing to Get to Fish-man Island: The Sabaody Archipelago
dub.description:
Enjoying takoyaki from a grateful Hatchan, he explains to the crew how to get to Fish-man Island.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Tyranny! The Rulers of Sabaody, the Celestial Dragons
dub.description:
Luffy and his crew stop at an island overflowing with bubbles to get their ship modified for underwater travel. But it`s not long before they stumble upon an outrageous explosion and attract unwanted attention.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: New Rivals Gather! The 11 Supernovas
dub.description:
Shakky explains why Sabaody Archipelago seems to be crawling with bounty hunters – eleven of the Grand Line`s most wanted pirates are currently ashore and two of them are in Luffy`s crew!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Target is Camie! The Looming Clutches of a Professional Kidnapper
dub.description:
A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Rescue Camie! The Archipelago's Lingering Dark History
dub.description:
Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they’ll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Time Limit: The Human Auction Begins
dub.description:
With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami’s concocted a very generous plan!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Fist Explodes! Destroy the Auction
dub.description:
Nami’s plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed celestial dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Straw Hats Defeated?! Hordy Gains Control of the Ryugu Palace!
dub.description:
Zoro and Neptune fight bravely, but they`re no match for Hordy and his pill-popping minions. Back at the ship, Luffy reunites with Jimbei, who reveals something sinister about his past.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Haunting Ties! Nami and the Fish-Man Pirates!
dub.description:
The New Fish-Man Pirates continue their bloody and violent uprising, and Jimbei begins the story of how he unleashed the monster known as Arlong on the unsuspecting citizens of the East Blue.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Hero Who Freed the Slaves! An Adventurer Tiger!
dub.description:
Jimbei continues his story with tales of fish-men taken as slaves, Queen Otohime`s fierce devotion to her people, the legend of Fisher Tiger, and the sinister rise of Arlong.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Kizaru Appears! A Trap to Catch Tiger!
dub.description:
Arlong`s violent tendencies are condemned by Fisher Tiger, and the arrival of a young human girl teaches the Fish-Man Pirates a lesson in compassion.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Death of a Hero! A Shocking Truth of Tiger!
dub.description:
The great pirate Fisher Tiger keeps his promise to a young slave girl, but the adults in her village are determined to make him pay for his act of honor.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Sun Pirates Split! Jimbei vs Arlong!
dub.description:
In the wake of Fisher Tiger`s tragic death, the once-mighty Sun Pirates are splintered by an ongoing quarrel between Jimbei and Arlong. Meanwhile, Queen Otohime`s ceasless quest to help her people begins to take its toll.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Shaking Fish-Man Island! A Celestial Dragon Drifts In!
dub.description:
Tensions run high when a slave-owning Celestial Dragon washes up on Fish-Man Island. His former captives cry for out for blood, but Queen Otohime sees it as a chance to mend fences between the gilled and non-gilled!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Sudden Tragedy! A Gunshot Shuts Down the Future!
dub.description:
After an agonizing absence, Queen Otohime returns to her people with exciting news. Unfortunately, a horrific act of violence derails the queen`s mission and changes life on Fish-Man Island forever.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Back to the Present! Hordy Makes a Move!
dub.description:
Jimbei reaches the heartbreaking conclusion in the story of Queen Otohime, Nami does something completely unexpected, and Hordy Jones makes a foreboding appearance!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Kingdom Quivers - Neptune's Execution Command
dub.description:
Hordy announces his sinister plans for Fish-Man Island. Luffy and Shirahoshi are ready to fight, but Jimbei wants to wage this war on his own!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Rift Opens Up! Luffy vs. Jimbei!
dub.description:
Luffy and Jimbei come to blows over how to handle Hordy`s uprising. Back at the palace, Brook embarks on an out of body experience with hopes of saving his mates!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Something Has Happened to Hordy! The True Power of the Evil Drug!
dub.description:
Jimbei and Luffy continue their standoff, the New Fish-Man pirates go on a rampage, and Hordy begins to experience startling side effects from his pill-popping habit!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Battle is on! At Conchcorde Plaza!
dub.description:
Hordy`s rampant use of the energy steroid makes him bigger, stronger, and scarier than ever before! The Fish-Man princes join the battle, but even they may not be strong enough to stop Hordy`s onslaught!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Surprising Confession! The Truth Behind the Assassination of Otohime!
dub.description:
Jimbei and Shirahoshi are captured by the enemy, and Hordy makes a shocking revelation to the population of Fish-Man Island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Shirahoshi's Tears! Luffy Finally Shows Up!
dub.description:
Shirahoshi reveals that she knew the truth about her mother`s murder all along, and Luffy makes a bone-crushing entrance when the princess needs him most!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Great Clash! The Straw Hat Crew vs. 100,000 Enemies
dub.description:
Hordy announces his plan for turning humans into slaves, the people of Fish-Man Island throw their support behind a new champion, and Luffy amazes even his own friends!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Deadly Attacks One After Another! Zoro and Sanji Join The Battle!
dub.description:
Luffy and the gang show off how much stronger they`ve become by issuing a brutal beat down to Hordy and his ferocious Fish-Man Pirates! Can anything stop the Hats?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Unveiled! The Secret Weapons of the Sunny!
dub.description:
Hordy`s men keep attacking, but the Straw Hats have new weapons at their disposal! Franky unleashes the fury of the Black Rhino, and Luffy turns the tables on Hordy with a little help from his Kraken!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Iron Pirate! Here Comes General Franky!
dub.description:
Franky dazzles Usopp and Chopper by transforming into a gigantic fighting robot, Hordy tries to blackmail the Kraken, and Luffy introduces his fist to the Fish-man`s face!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Noah Closing in! The Fish-Man Island Facing Destruction!
dub.description:
Luffy shows off even more new powers as he brutally pummels Hordy, but the main attraction proves to be an ancient and immense pirate ship that`s heading straight for Fish-Man Island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Hurry up, Luffy! Shirahoshi's Life in Jeopardy!
dub.description:
Shirahoshi summons the courage to risk everything to save her world, Luffy puts his own life in peril by venturing into the ocean, and Hordy`s devious nature fully comes to the surface.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Fierce Fight Begins! Luffy vs. Hordy!
dub.description:
Luffy sets the stage for a final battle with Hordy, Sanji kicks a giant in defense of Nami`s honor, and Zoro puts his blades to the ultimate test against a steroid-powered fighting fish!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Massive Confused Fight! The Straw Hats vs. the New Fish-Man Pirates!
dub.description:
While Luffy and Shirahoshi try to prevent Fish-Man Island from being crushed, the rest of the Straw Hats square off against the meanest Fish-Man Pirates in the deep blue sea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai's Horrifying Severed Head!
dub.description:
Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less Samurai! Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks into the Ice-cold Lake!
dub.description:
Luffy`s group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami`s group and cast our heroes into chaotic confusion!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!
dub.description:
Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law, but a reunion with his mixed up crew - and the loss of his extra legs - quickly dampens the captain`s enthusiasm!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!
dub.description:
While Captain Smoker determines his next move, a very large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard`s mysterious transformation!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea
dub.description:
Featured characters of One Piece, Toriko and Dragon Ball enter the IGO tournament in order to gain the Carat meat, which is said to be the most tasteful in the world. However, it leads in a tie between Goku, Toriko and Luffy. Meanwhile, Zoro, Zebra and Vegeta meet accidentally in a remote part of the race, and start fighting.
Source: http://onepiece.fandom.com/

dub.title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!
dub.description:
The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!
dub.description:
The story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed, and the Yeti Cool Brothers set their sights on a showdown with the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!
dub.description:
Luffy tries to chase down the Yetti Cool Brothers, but Franky`s still trapped in Chopper`s Body makes his mission extremely difficult. Just when all appears lost, an unexpected ally lends a hand!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!
dub.description:
Luffy agrees to an alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master unleashes something very deadly!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!
dub.description:
Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, Trafalgar tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory, and Luffy boldly challenges the Master!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!
dub.description:
Luffy`s battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob - and the evil genius who created the monster!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!
dub.description:
Sanji puts Nami`s beautiful body at risk to save the torso of a Samurai, and Luffy appears to have gained the upper hand in his battle with Ceasar - until the gas bag unleashes something sinister!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Samurai Who Can Cut Fire! Foxfire Kin'emon!
dub.description:
Trafalgar Law finds trouble in the form of an old acquaintance, Chopper investigates the Master`s lab, and the mysterious Samurai shows what he can do with a full body!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Shocking! The True Identity of the Mystery Man Vergo!
dub.description:
The Master gathers his young test subjects, shocking secret identities are finally revealed, and the poisonous purple blob continues its march across the island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Save the Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close in!
dub.description:
Nami and Usopp get an unexpected helping hand in their fight to save the children, Chopper plots a daring escape attempt, and the Master markets his greatest weapon!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Shaking Up the New World! Caesar's Horrendous Experiment!
dub.description:
A desperate need for candy leads the children to return to the lab, and Caesar plans to show the world the new and improved version of Smiley!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Deadliest Weapon of Mass Destruction in History! Shinokuni!
dub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats find themselves pursued by a deadly cloud of purple gas that turns everything living thing in its path into petrified statues of ash!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Launching the Counter Attack! Luffy and Law's Great Escape!
dub.description:
Law`s got a trick up his sleeve that could mean the difference between life and death. Zoro and company reunite with Nami and Sanji, but can they reach safety before being swallowed by a poisonous cloud!?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Get to Building R! The Pirate Alliance's Great Advance!
dub.description:
Finally reunited and returned to their proper bodies, the Straw Hats fall in line as Luffy and Law lead the charge to settle the score with Caesar - and save the children!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Tashigi's Tears! G-5's Desperate Breakthrough Plan!
dub.description:
Caesar hatches a plan to forever silence his enemies, Chopper races through the compound in search of the drugged children, and Tashigi`s men make the ultimate sacrifice!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Treacherous Vice Admiral! Demon Bamboo Vergo!
dub.description:
Luffy races toward Caesar in the hopes of delivering a beating, Sanji saves a damsel in distress, and Chopper tries to prevent the children from eating the drugged candy!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Fierce Battle Gets Heated! Luffy vs. Caesar!
dub.description:
Sanji and Vergo slug it out in a cloud of toxic gas, Law finds the room that could ruin the New World, and Luffy hopes to bring Caesar`s reign of terror to a brutal end!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Mastermind Underground! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
dub.description:
Doflamingo orders Vergo to stop Law in his tracks, Luffy battles a deadly snowbird, and the rest of the Straw Hats attempt to survive the fiery breath of an angry dragon!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Luffy Dies from Exposure?! The Spine-chilling Snow Woman Monet!
dub.description:
Luffy goes down fast after Monet puts a chill into him, and Trafalgar Law makes a desperate attempt to reclaim his heart during an electric battle with Vergo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Fists Collide! A Battle of the Two Vice Admirals!
dub.description:
Smoker attacks Vergo for assaulting his men, Luffy meets something strange in the trash heap, and a flashback reveals the true depths of Caesar`s madness!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Small Dragon! Momonosuke Appears!
dub.description:
Luffy befriends a dragon that used to be a human boy, and Captain Smoker continues his brutal battle with the villainous Vergo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Deadly Fight in a Blizzard! The Straw Hats vs. The Snow Woman!
dub.description:
Luffy hitches a ride on a dragon, Mocha tries to keep the Master`s candy away from her friends, and Zoro pits his steel against snow in a battle with Monet!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Showing Off His Techniques! Zoro's Formidable One-Sword Style!
dub.description:
To survive his battle with Monet, Zoro must overcome his unwillingness to cut a woman. Elsewhere, Luffy puts a hungry dragon on his back and tries to punch his way out of the basement!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: To Save Her Friends! Mocha Runs at the Risk of Her Life!
dub.description:
Chopper, Nami, and Robin watch in horror as Mocha makes a heartbreaking sacrifice in a courageous attempt to save the lives of her friends!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Brownbeard in Grief! Luffy Lands a Furious Blow!
dub.description:
Brownbeard heroically attempts to expose Caesar as a villain, the horrific truth about Punk Hazard is finally revealed, and Luffy puts the hurt on his gaseous enemy!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Surprising Outcome! White Chase vs. Vergo!
dub.description:
Luffy makes Caesar pay for his crimes against the children, and Smoker risks his life for a chance to see Vergo fall in battle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Caesar's Defeat! The Powerful Grizzly Magnum!
dub.description:
Law reaches the end of his epic battle with Vergo, and Luffy looks to land a devastating final blow on the murderous gasbag Caesar!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Raid! An Assassin From Dressrosa!
dub.description:
Word of Luffy and Law`s alliance spreads throughout the world, Chopper and Brook race to stay ahead of the deadly gas, and Joker sends a team to rescue Caesar!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Running Wild! Invincible General Franky!
dub.description:
Franky battles a lethal beauty, Caesar tries to strike a final blow against Smoker, and Monet detonates an explosive surprise that could spell doom for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Critical Situation! Punk Hazard Explodes!
dub.description:
As the Straw Hats and company flee the crumbling laboratory, Caesar`s desperate act of vengeance thwarts Joker`s plan to forever silence his enemies!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Capture Caesar! General Cannon Blasts!
dub.description:
Franky continues his battle with Buffalo and Baby 5, Nami uses a mighty gust of wind to save the children from a deadly cloud of gas, and Usopp takes a shot at capturing Caesar!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Touching Reunion! Momonosuke and Kin'emon!
dub.description:
A dragon regains his boyish form, a noble warrior once feared dead makes a shocking resurrection, and bitter enemies set aside their differences to enjoy a well-deserved feast!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: It's Time to Say Goodbye! Leaving Punk Hazard!
dub.description:
The weary marines and the rescued children get teary-eyed as they say goodbye to the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Law enters into treacherous negotiations with Joker!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The G-5 Wiped Out! Doflamingo's Sudden Attack!
dub.description:
The Straw Hats set a course for Dressrosa, Law explains his alliance with Luffy, and Smoker`s refusal to reveal a secret earns him a serious beating from Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Intense! Aokiji vs. Doflamingo!
dub.description:
Smoker`s life is spared by the arrival of an old friend. Law reveals some shocking news about Caesar`s partnership with Doflamingo, and Momonosuke uses his youth to get cozy with Robin and Nami!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes a Sortie!
dub.description:
Smooth seas stretch out before the Straw Hats as they leave Punk Hazard far behind. While they fear Donflamingo`s return and prepare to face him, another powerful foe lies in wait - one whose power could be their downfall!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Luffy Dies at Sea!? The Pirate Alliance Comes Apart!
dub.description:
Breed uses his evil abilities to turn Chopper into a pet - and force Luffy and Law to fight to the death.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Major Turnaround! Luffy's Angry Iron Fist Strikes!
dub.description:
After Law discovers the secret to Breed`s power, Luffy and his old friend the Kung Fu Dugong give the animal-abusing madman a beasty beat down!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Startling! The Big News Shakes Up The New World!
dub.description:
As the world reacts to Doflamingo`s shocking announcement, Law and the Straw Hats plot the next move in their daring alliance, and a face from the past returns!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Explore! A Kingdom of Love and Passion Dressrosa!
dub.description:
The Straw Hats and their friends set out to explore Dressrosa, a land full of beautiful women, delicious food, and live toys that walk amongst the living.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Full of Enthusiasm! The Corrida Colosseum!
dub.description:
A blind warrior lays a beat down on a gang of masked thugs, Zorro chases the thief who stole his sword, and Luffy finds himself tempted by the promise of a fiery fruit!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Dangerous Love! The Dancer Girl - Violet!
dub.description:
Zoro continues his hunt for the fairy who stole his sword, Sanji is smitten by a beautiful dancer, and Luffy prepares to fight for the Devil Fruit that belonged to his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Formidable, Unknown Warrior! Here Comes Lucy!
dub.description:
Sanji falls further under the spell of his new lady friend, and Luffy makes quite an impression as he gets to know the fighters competing for Ace`s Devil Fruit.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Pirate Noble! Cavendish!
dub.description:
A gorgeous gladiator tells Luffy the story of the world`s greatest warrior, a masked mauler literally destroys the competition, and the Navy makes its presence felt!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Fateful Reunion! Bellamy the Hyena!
dub.description:
An old nemesis sees through Luffy`s disguise, Zoro finally catches up to the sword-stealing fairy, and Sanji`s skill at sniffing out snipers impresses his new lady friend!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Super Rookie! Bartolomeo the Cannibal!
dub.description:
Bartolomeo and Bellamy take center stage in the latest round of the battle royal, but a slugger with a serious punch threatens to steal their thunder. Meanwhile, Luffy is targeted by an angry behemoth!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Big Names Duke It Out! The Heated Block B Battle!
dub.description:
An old enemy of Garp`s reveals Luffy`s true identity, landing the Straw Hat captain in hot water with one of his fellow competitors. Meanwhile, the battle in Block B gets supremely brutal!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch!
dub.description:
Franky`s new robot friend promises to reveal the tragic secrets of Dressrosa, and a regal brawler prepares to throw a powerful punch that could destroy the entire colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Fishing Fish Strike! Across the Deadly Iron Bridge!
dub.description:
While Law, Robin, Usopp, and Caesar attempt to survive a Fighting Fish attack, Sanji learns the heartbreaking truth about the beautiful woman who stole his heart!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Explore! Fairies' Island - Green Bit!
dub.description:
Luffy`s turn to fight in the epic colosseum battle draws near, Zoro has an interesting encounter with a surprisingly strong fairy, and the thoughts in Sanji`s head shock his lady captor!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Unknown World! The Tontatta Kingdom!
dub.description:
Sanji learns some disturbing news that could mean trouble for his friends, Luffy prepares for a fight, and Robin is captured by a village full of little people!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Stratagem of the Century! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
dub.description:
Despite Sanji`s attempt to warn him, Law finds his life in danger after being ambushed by Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Luffy is unable to hide his true identity once the fists start flying!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Shaking Heaven and Earth! Admiral Fujitora's Power!
dub.description:
After his plan falls apart, Law must fight for his life against two powerful opponents. Elsewhere, Sanji bids a touching goodbye to his special lady friend, and Luffy tangles with Brutal Bull!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Blow of Anger! A Giant vs. Lucy!
dub.description:
Nami, Chopper, and Brook are grotesquely transformed by a hideous woman who fancies herself an artist. Back at the colosseum, Luffy gets serious when his new friend falls victim to a giant attack!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Destruction Cannon Blasts! Lucy in Trouble!
dub.description:
Zoro and his fairy friend argue over directions, Trafalgar Law finds himself outnumbered in his battle with Doflamingo, and Luffy`s latest opponent packs an explosive punch!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Legendary Pirate! Don Chinjao!
dub.description:
While Nami, Chopper, and Brook attempt to take back the Sunny, Luffy and the monstrous mauler Don Chinjao take their brutal grudge match to a legendary level!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Light and Shadow! Darkness behind Dressrosa!
dub.description:
Luffy`s battle with Don Chinjao heats up, Franky learns the tragic truth behind Dressrosa`s mysterious toy population, and Robin and Usopp prepare to join their little friends in battle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Making a Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland!
dub.description:
Luffy continues his battle with Don Chinjao, Franky and Zoro are reunited in the land of the little people, and Law is wounded in a revealing, face-to-face showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Fierce Battle Coming to the End! Lucy vs. Chinjao!
dub.description:
A flashback reveals the story of how Garp changed Chinjao`s world forever. Back in the present, Luffy and his opponent trade ferocious blows that literally rock the colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Luffy and the Gladiator of Fate - Rebecca!
dub.description:
During a break between battles, Luffy is attacked by an angry rival, but a beautiful gladiator with mysterious motives offers him food - and a place to rest.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Protect You to the End! Rebecca and the Toy Soldier!
dub.description:
In the moments before battle, the beautiful gladiator Rebecca flashes back to the tragic events of her childhood and the toy soldier who became her constant companion.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Last - and Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins!
dub.description:
The bloodthirsty crowd hurls insults at Rebecca as the battle of Block D begins. On the other side of the island, Law finds himself on the losing end of his battle with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. the Straw Hats!
dub.description:
Brook`s trickery springs the Straw Hats from their artistic prison, but their failure to cuff the culprit means they`ll need help from a cola-powered cannon to emerge victorious!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish of the White Horse!
dub.description:
Cavendish wins over the female fans during the Block D battle, Luffy keeps an eye on Rebecca, and Sanji heads toward a heated collision with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Big Clash! Sanji vs. Doflamingo
dub.description:
Sanji`s battle with Doflamingo is interrupted by Law`s sudden arrival, and Rebecca continues her impressive showing in the battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Rebecca's Special Attack! Last-Ditch Sword Dance!
dub.description:
Law begins a deadly, face-to-face battle with Doflamingo, Zoro enlists the aid of a star struck gladiator, and Rebecca continues to impresses Luffy with her unique fighting style!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Most Violent Fighter! Logan vs Rebecca!
dub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Big Surprise! The True Identity Of The Toy Soldier!
dub.description:
Rebecca`s battle continues, a madman turns a gladiator into a play thing, and the brave little toy soldier reveals his painful past – and the tragic truth behind King Riku`s fall from power!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Horrible Past! The Secret of Dressrosa
dub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Nightmare! The Tragic Night of Dressrosa!
dub.description:
Rebecca continues her valiant stand in the arena of battle, Luffy is reunited with Zoro, and the heartbreaking story of how Doflamingo conquered Dressrosa continues!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Showdown Between the Warlords! Law vs. Doflamingo!
dub.description:
Law`s power begins to fade, making him an easy target for Doflamingo`s vicious attacks. Meanwhile, Franky begs Luffy to let him fight alongside Soldier and the little people!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Two Great Rivals Meet Each Other! Straw Hat and Heavenly Demon!
dub.description:
Luffy sets his sights on a showdown with Doflamingo in a desperate attempt to save Law`s life. Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Brook are attacked by a very deadly foe!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Luffy Astonished! The Man Who Inherits Ace's Will!
dub.description:
Soldier reveals his daring plan to return all the toys to their human forms, and Luffy has an emotional encounter with someone from his very distant past!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Operation SOP Starts! Usoland Charges Forth!
dub.description:
Usopp and Robin join the little people on their mission to turn the toys back into humans, Franky wreaks havoc at the toy house, and Rebecca continues her gladiator battle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Burning Passion! Rebecca vs. Suleiman!
dub.description:
Zoro attracts unwanted attention by upsetting a child, Soldier risks his life to lead the attack on Doflamingo, and Rebecca struggles to survive the brutal battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The End of the Match?! A Surprising Result of Block D!
dub.description:
Rebecca survives an encounter with an opponent`s deadly alter ego, Franky continues his battle with a man who dresses like a baby, and Violet offers to sneak Luffy into the palace!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Admiral's Decision! Fujitora vs. Doflamingo!
dub.description:
Franky has his hands full battling a host of enemies at the Toy House, Violet leads Luffy to a secret entrance into the palace, and Fujitora issues Doflamingo a grave warning!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Final Round Starts! Diamante The Hero Shows Up!
dub.description:
Diamante`s unique abilities and the presence of special Fighting Fish add a deadly wrinkle to the tournament`s final round. Elsewhere, Luffy spoils any chance of sneaking up on Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Moving Castle! The Top Executive Pica Rises up!
dub.description:
Luffy tangles with a monster made of stone, Franky bursts into flames after getting shot by a cannon, and the courageous little people hatch a plan to turn the toys back into humans!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Dragon Claw Strikes! Lucy's Intimidating Attack!
dub.description:
Soldier takes a beating from a Doflamingo Family Executive, Lucy shows off a powerful new fighting style, and Zoro pushes his blades to the breaking point in a showdown with a man made of stone!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Defeat Sugar! The Army of the Little People Charges!
dub.description:
Zoro repeatedly slices his stone opponent into pieces, but he can`t find a way to make the bad guy stay down. Meanwhile, the bravery of the little people could get them turned into toys!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Last Light of Hope! The Secret of Our Commander!
dub.description:
The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol’s furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier’s stunning true identity! Meanwhile, with the help of another Tontatta group, the Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Rupture Human! Gladius Blows Up Big Time!
dub.description:
Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly-indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Liar! Usoland on the Run!
dub.description:
With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others all busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol? Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make - run and fight another day or face his own doom and challenge Trebol!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Fateful Encounter! Kyros and King Riku!
dub.description:
The deep and tragic story of Kyros is revealed! The legend of this invincible gladiator is tied up with the royal family of Dressrosa! Meanwhile, Trebol`s defeat at the hands of Usopp is not a sure thing yet!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Operation Failed! Usoland the Hero Dies!?
dub.description:
In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo`s chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy, and all hopes rest on Usopp to provide the miracle everyone needs!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Legend is Back! Kyros' All-Out Attack!
dub.description:
Usopp manages to knock Sugar out and Operation SOP is accomplished! The toys in Dressrosa start turning back to their original forms and the people are slowly realizing who Doflamingo really is! In the meantime, the legendary hero Kyros reverts to his true form - and this mighty champion of the Colosseum has a score to settle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Fire Fist Strikes! The Flare-Flare Fruit Power Returns!
dub.description:
Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo’s clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring! Will he be able to snag the Flare-Flare Fruit?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Dashing onto the Scene! The Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army - Sabo!
dub.description:
Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his new-found followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo`s defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but the Young Master may have a trick left up his sleeve...
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Devil's Trap! A Dressrosa Extermination Plan!
dub.description:
The mystery of Doflamingo`s return from the dead is revealed! But there isn`t much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The 500 Million Berry Man! Target: Usoland!
dub.description:
As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game - targeting Luffy, King Riku, and Law, but with the highest bounty reserved for Usopp!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Breaking through Enemy Lines! Luffy and Zoro Launch the Counter-Attack!
dub.description:
Doflamingo and Fujitora`s agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace along with Zoro and Law, Fujitora stands in his way!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!
dub.description:
Robin, Usopp, the Tontatta`s and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo`s deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin`emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town and changes the stakes of the game!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
dub.description:
With Luffy and the others recovering from Pica`s attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out - to decide who gets to take down Doflamingo once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Steady Progress! Luffy's Army vs. Pica!
dub.description:
Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica’s giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action, summoning all the Navy soldiers on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!
dub.description:
Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law`s handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him. Finally, Law`s reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!
dub.description:
Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo`s refuge, making his way through Doflamingo`s guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit! But with Fujitora`s ability to call down a meteor, will Sabo have to power to save himself?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
dub.description:
Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas to catch up with Luffy and Law!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Great Escape! Luffy's Tide-turning Elephant Gun!
dub.description:
Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum to defend himself and protect Robin and Rebecca!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A United Front – Luffy's Breakthrough Towards Victory!
dub.description:
The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other`s necks towards a unified plan, which might just be enough to get Luffy the chance to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Second Samurai – Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears
dub.description:
Hidden far underground, Kin`emon finds his old friend Kanjuro, whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along - and that the only way to win is to take the Warlord down!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Struggle with Pica – Zoro's One Finishing Move
dub.description:
The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Little People's Princess! Captive Mansherry!
dub.description:
Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky while Señor Pink, wise to Frankie`s deception, arrives on the scene ready for a manly showdown!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!
dub.description:
Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below - and directly into Luffy and the others` battle with the creepy Headcracker Dolls!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!
dub.description:
Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process? Meanwhile, Sabo tastes Fujitora`s full might!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!
dub.description:
Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo -- but Sugar stands in their way!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!
dub.description:
Usopp uses Viola`s Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster -- and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp`s ammunition has been specially designed for this specific situation!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!
dub.description:
The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy`s own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!
dub.description:
All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora’s true intention…
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
dub.description:
With Fujitora`s stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Sad Memories! Law the Boy from the White Town!
dub.description:
The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law`s traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy`s Stormy Past!
dub.description:
Law`s attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he`s accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon`s mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law`s life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon`s Journey of Life!
dub.description:
Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon`s actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Time Is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
dub.description:
Corazon`s double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon`s Farewell Smile!
dub.description:
The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon`s hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island; the location of Corazon and Law!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man`s Final Fight!
dub.description:
Doflamingo and his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law`s whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape - even if that means sacrificing his own life. However, when things turn sour, it`s a chain of lucky coincidences that allows the plan to be set into motion - almost as though someone or something is keeping Law alive!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Attack on a Celestial! Luffy`s King Kong Gun of Anger!
dub.description:
Luffy regains enough Haki to face off against Doflamingo, but his health is still poor. With the Birdcage closing in, is there a technique left in his repertoire that is strong enough to take down Doflamingo?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: To Be Free! Dressrosa`s Delight!
dub.description:
With Doflamingo thoroughly quashed and the Birdcage collapsing, the people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy remembering the hardships they`ve endured, and the actions taken by Luffy and the others to free them.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Unheard-of! Admiral Fujitora`s Surprising Decision!
dub.description:
Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates tries to agitate Sabo, mocking Ace`s final words in order to unsettle him enough that he can try to steal the Flare-Flare Fruit! Meanwhile, people of Dressrosa beg King Riku to resume the crown when Navy Admiral Fujitora steps in and takes a stunning action!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Sending a Shockwave! The Worst Generation Goes Into Action!
dub.description:
Repercussions of Doflamingo`s defeat reverberate around the world! Fujitora`s actions put the Navy in a tight spot, and the "Worst Generation" beings to stir into action!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Birth of the Legend! The Adventures of the Revolutionary Warrior Sabo!
dub.description:
The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Brothers` Bond! The Untold Story Behind Luffy and Sabo`s Reunion!
dub.description:
Sabo recounts his surprising reunion with Luffy at the Colosseum as the Straw Hats and the others continue to recoup. Meanwhile, Fujitora gambles on how to make his next move - and the odds are in Luffy`s favor!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Strongest Creature! One of the Four Emperors: Kaido, King of the Beasts!
dub.description:
As Sabo departs, our attention shifts to the other Straw Hats waging a fierce battle on a mysterious island. And a new drama is set into motion as ill portents fall from the sky!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Fujitora Takes Action! The Complete Siege of the Straw Hats!
dub.description:
As Luffy and the others begin to come to their senses, major players in the Navy arrive to search Dressrosa for the Straw Hats! Also, Rebecca`s history is whitewashed with a fake cover story - but why?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: A State of Emergency! Rebecca Is Kidnapped!
dub.description:
Fujitora`s flirting with chance has turned out poorly for the Straw Hats as the full Navy force bears down on Dressrosa searching for the pirates! Luffy and the others make a mad dash for the east port to get off the island, but not without finishing up a piece of business...
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Bond Between Father and Daughter! Kyros and Rebecca!
dub.description:
Rebecca has precious little time to follow Luffy`s lead and make it to Kyros. Can she make it in time? Meanwhile, Fujitora is closing in on Bartolomeo and the other Colosseum warriors while Trafalgar Law faces the shadows of his past!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Men`s Pride! Luffy vs. Fujitora, Head-to-Head!
dub.description:
Law and Sengoku share memories of Corazon, and the secret of Trafalgar Law`s name. Meanwhile, Fujitora uses the destruction caused by the battle in Dressrosa as a weapon, and squares off one-on-one with Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: No Way Out! Admiral Fujitora`s Ruthless Pursuit!
dub.description:
The people of Dressrosa show their appreciation to the Straw Hats one last time by foiling Fujitora`s strategy. As Luffy and the others are able to finally make their break from the island, however, an unbelievable new chapter opens in the story of the Straw Hat Pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Sons` Cups! The Straw Hat Fleet Is Formed!
dub.description:
With newfound allies won in the battle at Dressrosa, and as the Navy watches, Luffy and the Straw Hats depart Dressrosa for open water. But will Luffy accept the oath of allegiance given by his new fleet?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Numerous Rivals Struggle Amongst Themselves! The Raging Monsters of the New World
dub.description:
While the Straw Hats are underway, Doflamingo has serious predictions for the upset of the world order! Meanwhile, the recent actions in Dressrosa have led to surprising results!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The King of the Night! Master Cat Viper Emerges!
dub.description:
Day turns to night as the Minks keep up their onslaught against the invading Beast Pirates! But Jack`s amazing Devil Fruit power may end the elephant island once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Exterminated Capital! The Twirly Hat Crew Arrive!
dub.description:
Night and day, Jack faces the fury of the two sworn defenders of Zou, but while they put up a good fight, the Minks aren`t able to subdue Jack, especially after he brings out his secret weapon...
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Time Limit Closes In! The Bond Between the Mink Tribe and the Crew!
dub.description:
In the aftermath of Jack`s deadly attack on the island of Zou, Chopper and Sanji rush in to save the fallen Mink Tribe - but they will need the help of Caesar to overcome the poisonous effects of the gas!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Delinquent Comes Home! Emperor Big Mom`s Assassins!
dub.description:
More of the dramatic happenings on Zou are revealed as we learn that Jack`s pirate band were not the only visitors to the elephant island! And what about the mysterious fate of Sanji?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: The Truth Behind the Disappearance! Sanji Gets a Startling Invitation!
dub.description:
The mystery of Sanji`s disappearance deepens as Luffy learns that Big Mom`s lackeys have caught up with him and the rest - and carry with them an invitation from Big Mom that simply can`t be refused!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: To My Buds! Sanji`s Farewell Note!
dub.description:
Sanji`s dire situation has become clear, but instead of rallying against Big Mom`s crew, he submits to go along with them to bring an end to this situation. But being separated from one of his crew is more than Luffy is willing to tolerate!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Let`s Go and Meet Master Cat Viper!
dub.description:
